Two landmark phase III trials establish PCV chemotherapy added to radiotherapy as standard of care: EORTC 26951 (van den Bent et al. JCO 2013 / 12-yr update Cairncross JCO 2013): 374 pts, anaplastic oligodendroglioma; RT alone vs RT + PCV; in the 1p/19q-codeleted subgroup: mOS 14+ yr with RT+PCV vs 9.3 yr RT alone (HR ~0.5). Benefit confined to codeleted tumors. RTOG 9802 (Shaw et al. : AKT1 E17K activating mutation in HR+/H: : AKT1 E17K activando la mutación en HR+/HER2- cáncer de mama metastásico — prevalencia ~3-6%. Capivasertib + fulvestrant (CAPItello-291) está aprobado por la FDA para HR+/HER2- avanzada madre que alberga PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN alteración después de la progresión endocrina ± CDK4/6i.
: ALK rearrangement / fusion (typically: : Rearreglo de ALK / fusión (normalmente EML4-ALK) — ~5% de adenocarcinoma NSCLC; nunca fumador / joven enriquecido. Definición del tratamiento: alectinib (ALEX — mPFS 34,8 mo) o lorlatinib (CROWN — 5-y PFS 60%) prefirió 1L sobre crizotinib. Adjuvante alectinib 2 y después de la resección (ALINA).
: AML eligible for CPX-351 (Vyxeos) lipo: : AML eligible for CPX-351 (Vyxeos) liposomal cytarabine+daunorubicin per the FDA-approved subset: therapy-related AML (t-AML, post-cytotoxic / post-radiation), AML with myelodysplasia-related changes (AML-MRC) per WHO criteria (multilineage dysplasia OR MDS-related cytogenetics OR antecedent MDS/CMML). Phase-3 Lancet 2018 (Lancet 2018;392:2088; Lancet Haematology 2020;7:e552 5-yr follow-up): mOS 9.56 vs 5.95 mo for 7+3, HR 0.69; 5-yr OS 18% vs 8%. Eligibility window age 60-75 + fit-for-intensive-chemo. Routes 1L AML to CPX-351-SECONDARY indication over standard 7+3 when this RF fires.
: AML patient frail or elderly unfit for: : AML patient frail or elderly unfit for intensive induction: age ≥75, OR age ≥65 with ≥2 comorbidities (HCT-CI ≥3), OR ECOG ≥2 with multiple comorbidities, OR explicit clinical assessment 'unfit for intensive chemotherapy'
: AML with FLT3-ITD or FLT3-TKD mutation: : AML with FLT3-ITD or FLT3-TKD mutation — addition of midostaurin (or gilteritinib in r/r) to induction is required (RATIFY trial)
: AML with core-binding-factor (CBF) cyt: : AML with core-binding-factor (CBF) cytogenetics: t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 fusion OR inv(16)(p13.1q22) / t(16;16)(p13.1;q22) with CBFB::MYH11 fusion. ~10-15% of de novo adult AML, ~25% of pediatric AML. ELN 2022 favorable risk; standard 7+3 induction + 3-4 cycles HiDAC consolidation is curative-intent in CR1 (5-year OS 60-75%); upfront alloHCT is NOT recommended in CR1 default. Adding gemtuzumab ozogamicin to induction (ALFA-0701, AML-19) further improves OS specifically in CBF AML (HR 0.69). c-KIT mutations (D816, exon-8) co-occur in ~25% of CBF AML and may downgrade favorability — warrant MRD-directed approach.
: APL with Sanz high risk — WBC >10 ×10^: : APL with Sanz high risk — WBC >10 ×10^9/L at diagnosis — supports ATRA+ATO+idarubicin (or +gemtuzumab in selected protocols); higher early-death risk and warrants leukapheresis-avoidance + aggressive DIC management
: APL with active disseminated intravasc: : APL con coagulación intravascular diseminada activa (DIC): fibrinógeno < 150 mg/dL, PT/PTT prolongado, dímero D elevado, trombocitopenia + manifestaciones sanguíneas. Iniciar ATRA EN SUSPICIÓN CLÍNICA antes de confirmar citogenética.
: Acquired EGFR T790M (gatekeeper) mutat: : Mutación adquirida de EGFR T790M (portador) en la progresión de EGFR-TKI de 1er/2o gen (gefitinib, erlotinib, afatinib, dacomitinib) — impulsa un cambio de 2L a osimertinib (AURA3 — mPFS 10,1 vs 4,4 mo con pem de platino). Detectado en ctDNA NGS o rebiopsia de tejido.
: Actionable molecular driver detected (: : Conductor molecular accionable detectado (EGFR / ALK / ROS1 / KRAS G12C / BRAF V600E / MET ex14 / RET / NTRK / HER2 mut) — TKI / ADC dirigido por el conductor tiene precedencia sobre ICI ± quimioterapia independientemente de PD-L1 TPS.
: Active or recent (≤6 months) variceal: : Hemorragia variceal activa o reciente (≤6 meses) en paciente con CHC con cirrosis. Mandatos Evaluación de EGD + ligadura de banda variceal ANTES de cualquier régimen que contenga bevacizumab (atezo+bev, prerrequisito IMbrave150).
: Advanced/metastatic gastric or GE-junc: : Adenocarcinoma gástrico avanzado/metástatico o adenocarcinoma de unión GE con PD-L1 puntuación positiva combinada (CPS) ≥1 por 22C3 IHC. CheckMate-649 (Janjigian Lancet 2021; OS final 2024) estableció nivolumab + quimioterapia (FOLFOX o XELOX) sobre quimioterapia sola para CPS ≥5 (mOS 14,4 vs 11,1 mo, HR 0,71) con beneficio continuo en CPS ≥1 (HR 0,78). La FDA aprobó nivolumab + quimioterapia para HER2-negativo gástrico/GEJ adenocarcinoma 1L independientemente de CPS; EMA limita a CPS ≥5. NCCN/ESMO 2024 favorecen la adición de nivolumab a FOLFOX/XELOX para CPS ≥1 (con mayor preferencia en CPS ≥5).
: Age >70 OR ECOG ≥3 OR CrCl 50-70 mL/mi: : Edad >70 O ECOG ≥3 O CrCl 50-70 ml/min — HD-MTX de dosis completa (≥3,5 g/m2) tiene toxicidad excesiva; dosis reducidas de MTX (1-3 g/m2) ± rituximab considerada.
: Age ≥80 + ECOG ≥2 — nivo+ipi prohibiti: : Edad ≥80 + ECOG ≥2 — nivo+ipi prohibitivo; nivo+rela o pembro mono.
: BRAF V600E mutation in NSCLC adenocarc: : BRAF V600E mutation in NSCLC adenocarcinoma — ~1-2% prevalence. Dabrafenib + trametinib (BRF113928 — ORR 64% 1L, 63% 2L+) is the approved targeted regimen; encorafenib + binimetinib (PHAROS) is newer alternative. Non-V600 BRAF mutations are not actionable with these doublets.
: BRAF V600E mutation in mCRC: ~8-10% pr: : mutación BRAF V600E en mCRC: prevalencia de ~8-10%, pronóstico pobre (mediana de la OS mitad vs BRAF-WT en quimioterapia estándar). Cetuximab/panitumumab ineficaz. Encorafenib + cetuximab (BEACON CRC) se prefiere 2L+; algunos datos de 1L favorecen FOLFOXIRI + intensificación bev en el mutante BRAF MSS.
: BRAF V600E or V600K activating mutatio: : BRAF V600E o V600K activando la mutación en melanoma metastásico / irresecable — ~40-50% prevalencia melanoma cutáneo. Definición del tratamiento: BRAFi + MEKi doblet (dabrafenib + trametinib, encorafenib + binimetinib — COLUMBUS, vemurafenib + cobimetinib). Secuencia con anti-PD-1 (CheckMate-067, DREAMseq) — IO-primer preferido en la enfermedad de bajo volumen; BRAF+MEK primero en la enfermedad sintomática / alta LDH.
: BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variant (ger: : BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variant (germline OR somatic) in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma — ~20-25% prevalence (15% germline + ~7% somatic). Olaparib maintenance after platinum-based 1L (SOLO-1 — mPFS 56.0 vs 13.8 mo BRCA-mut) is treatment-defining; rucaparib + niraparib alternatives. SOLO-2 — 2L+ relapse maintenance.
: Bulky lymphoma disease: single nodal m: : Enfermedad del linfoma bullicioso: masa nodal única >=7 cm OR masa mediastinal >1/3 diámetro torácico OR carga sintomática significativa
: Burkitt lymphoma high-risk features: H: : Burkitt lymphoma high-risk features: HIV+ AND CD4 <100 OR ECOG ≥3 OR LDH >3× ULN OR CNS involvement OR bulky abdominal disease — selects more intensive CODOX-M/IVAC over DA-EPOCH-R
: CLL with del(17p) by FISH AND/OR TP53: : CLL with del(17p) by FISH AND/OR TP53 mutation by NGS — ~5-10% at diagnosis, rising to ~30-40% in R/R disease. Defines a chemoimmuno- refractory subset (FCR/BR contraindicated; chemo OS <2 years). 1L selection narrows to two targeted-only routes: continuous BTKi (acalabrutinib, zanubrutinib, ibrutinib) OR fixed-duration venetoclax + obinutuzumab (CLL14, Fischer NEJM 2019; del(17p)/TP53-mut subgroup mPFS >5 years). NCCN/ESMO 2024 prefer fixed-duration ven + obinutuzumab over continuous BTKi for patient-preference and cardiac/bleeding-risk profiles, while continuous BTKi preferred for high disease bulk or patients unable to tolerate TLS-prophylaxis ramp.
: CLL with high-risk genetics: TP53 muta: : CLL with high-risk genetics: TP53 mutation OR del(17p) OR IGHV-unmutated OR complex karyotype (≥3 abnormalities)
: CML chronic phase with Sokal high risk: : CML chronic phase with Sokal high risk — supports 2nd-generation TKI 1L (dasatinib / nilotinib / bosutinib) over imatinib for faster MMR/MR4.5 and improved long-term cumulative incidence of progression
: CML high-risk by ELTS (EUTOS Long-Term: : CML high-risk by ELTS (EUTOS Long-Term Survival score) — favors 2nd-generation TKI (nilotinib / dasatinib / bosutinib) over imatinib for faster deep molecular response and improved long-term outcomes
: CML in accelerated or blast phase: ≥10: : CML in accelerated or blast phase: ≥10% blasts in PB or BM (accelerated), ≥20% blasts (blast phase), or extramedullary blasts. Treatment intent shifts from chronic-phase TKI to acute-leukemia-style induction + alloHCT.
: CML with T315I gatekeeper mutation in: : CML with T315I gatekeeper mutation in the BCR-ABL1 kinase domain — resistant to all 1st/2nd-gen TKIs; requires ponatinib or asciminib (STAMP)
: CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift: : CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift mutation in the C-terminal regulatory domain (e.g., S338X, R334X) in Waldenström macroglobulinemia (WM). CXCR4 WHIM-like mutations co-occur with MYD88 L265P in ~30-40% of MYD88-mutant WM and cause constitutive CXCR4 signaling via loss of the C-terminal regulatory domain. These mutations confer relative resistance to BTK inhibitor (BTKi) monotherapy — lower overall response rate and major-response rate, slower IgM decline kinetics compared to CXCR4-WT MYD88-mutant WM (Treon NEJM 2015; Castillo Blood 2020). Fires to route ALGO-WM-2L step 1 to carfilzomib-based therapy (IND-WM-2L-CARFILZOMIB-CXCR4MUT) rather than zanubrutinib BTKi monotherapy (IND-WM-2L-ZANUBRUTINIB), as BTKi efficacy is substantially attenuated in CXCR4-mutated WM. Detection: CXCR4 C-terminal sequencing by targeted PCR + Sanger or NGS panel with CXCR4 C-terminus coverage. Note: standard NGS panels frequently omit CXCR4 C-terminus; dedicated assay required. Bone marrow aspirate with CD138+ enrichment preferred for adequate WM clone representation. CXCR4 mutation testing is recommended at WM diagnosis per NCCN B-Cell Lymphomas 2025 (alongside MYD88 L265P) to guide initial therapy selection. In CXCR4-mutated patients, BTKi monotherapy response is attenuated; proteasome-inhibitor-based regimens or BR are preferred 1L per NCCN/ESMO. In 2L, carfilzomib-based regimens offer benefit in BTKi-refractory or BTKi-intolerant CXCR4-mutated WM.
: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma stage III-I: : Linfoma Hodgkin clásico estadio III-IV (avanzado) - selecciona A+AVD (ECHELON-1) sobre ABVD si el brentuximab es accesible
: DLBCL with International Prognostic In: : DLBCL con índice de pronóstico internacional 4-5 (riesgo alto) - apoya la intensificación de Pola-R-CHP por POLARIX y desencadena la discusión de profilaxis CNS a través del CNS-IPI
: DLBCL con índice de pronóstico internacional ≥2 — selecciona el Pola-R-CHP intensificado sobre R-CHOP por evidencia POLARIX
: EGFR exon 19 deletion is the most comm: : La eliminación del exon 19 del EGFR es la mutación más común de sensibilidad al EGFR en el adenocarcinoma NSCLC (~45-50% de los casos de mutantes del EGFR). La terapia dirigida con 1L aprobada por la FDA/EMA es el osimertinib (FLAURA — mPFS 18,9 vs 10,2 mo, OS 38,6 vs 31,8 mo); MARIPOSA-2 establece 2L amivantamab + lazertinib + quimioterapia post-osimertinib progresión.
: EGFR exon 20 insertion — heterogeneous: : EGFR exon 20 insertion — heterogeneous in-frame insertions that sterically block 1st/2nd/3rd-gen EGFR-TKI binding. Targeted by amivantamab (EGFR-MET bispecific; CHRYSALIS / PAPILLON) and mobocertinib (where available). PAPILLON established 1L amivantamab + carboplatin/pemetrexed; CHRYSALIS supports 2L+ amivantamab monotherapy.
: ESR1 ligand-binding-domain mutation (D: : mutación del dominio de ligandos ESR1 (D538G, Y537S/N/C, L536H, E380Q) adquirida en ~30-40% de cánceres de mama metastásicos HR+/HER2- progresando en inhibidores de aromatasa. Predictivo para el elacestrant (SERD oral; EMERALD — mPFS 3,8 vs 1,9 mo en subgrupo ESR1-mut) post-AI.
: FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement in advan: : FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement in advanced/metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (~10–20% of iCCA; rare in extrahepatic / gallbladder). Treatment-defining for 2L+: pemigatinib (FIGHT-202 ORR 35.5%, mPFS 6.9 mo, mOS 21.1 mo; FDA Apr 2020) preferred when FGFR2 fusion confirmed; futibatinib (FOENIX-CCA2) covalent FGFR-TKI alternative, including some pemigatinib-resistance variants. Common partners: BICC1-FGFR2, FGFR2-AHCYL1, FGFR2-CCDC6.
: Fit performance status (ECOG 0-1): pat: : Estado de rendimiento adecuado (ECOG 0-1): el paciente es totalmente activo o restringido en actividad física intensa, pero ambulatorio y capaz de realizar trabajos ligeros. Elegible para la quimioterapia de dosis completas y regímenes intensivos (COEP, escalada BEACOPP, HD-MTX, consolidación ASCT, CAR-T).
: Fitness for FOLFIRINOX in metastatic P: : Aptitud para FOLFIRINOX en el PDAC metastático por PRODIGE-4 / ACCORD-11 criterios de inclusión (Conroy NEJM 2011): ECOG 0-1, edad ≤75 (≤76 por protocolo; convención <=70-75 en el mundo real), bilirrubina ≤1,5× ULN (stent postbiliar resuelto si es necesario), no comorbilidad cardíaca significativa, función hepática / renal / ósea-marre adecuada. Seleccione IND-PDAC-METASTATIC-1L-FOLFIRINOX sobre IND-PDAC-METASTATIC-1L-GEM-NAB-PAC (mOS 11.1 vs 6,8 mo en PRODIGE-4; compensación de toxicidad aceptable en pacientes en ajuste). Frail / ECOG ≥2 / bilirrubina elevada → de-escalada a gema-nab-paclitaxel (MPACT, Von Hoff NEJM 2013).
: Folate receptor alpha (FRα) high expre: : Folate receptor alpha (FRα) high expression (≥75% of viable tumor cells with ≥2+ membrane staining by VENTANA FOLR1 RxDx) in platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma. Mirvetuximab soravtansine (MIRASOL — mPFS 5.6 vs 4.0 mo, OS 16.5 vs 12.7 mo vs investigator-choice chemo) is FDA-approved 2L+ ADC.
: Follicular lymphoma NOT meeting any GE: : Follicular lymphoma NOT meeting any GELF criterion — low tumor burden — watch-and-wait candidate; no survival benefit shown for early treatment in asymptomatic low-burden FL
: Follicular lymphoma meeting GELF crite: : Linfoma folicular que cumple los criterios del GELF para una alta carga tumoral — cualquiera de: masa nodal ≥7 cm; ≥3 sitios nodales cada uno ≥3 cm; síntomas B; esplenomegalia por debajo del umbilico; derrame pleural/peritoneal; citopenia (Hb <10, plt <100K, ANC <1,5K) atribuible al linfoma; LDH >ULN; β2M elevado; enfermedad rápidamente progresiva
: Follicular lymphoma meeting any GELF c: : Linfoma folicular que cumple cualquier criterio del GELF - alta carga tumoral que justifica la terapia sistémica 1L (R-CHOP / BR / R-CVP / R2) en lugar de vigilar y esperar
: Follicular lymphoma with clinical feat: : Follicular lymphoma with clinical features concerning for transformation to aggressive lymphoma (typically DLBCL): rapid disease progression, isolated rapidly-growing nodal mass, sudden LDH rise, new B-symptoms, hypercalcemia, extranodal involvement onset
: Germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic var: : Germlina BRCA1 o BRCA2 variante patógena en HER2-negativo cáncer de mama (HR+ o TNBC). Olaparib (olimpiAD — mPFS 7,0 vs 4,2 mo vs quimioterapia) y talazoparib (EMBRAC — mPFS 8,6 vs 5,6 mo) están aprobados por la FDA para gBRCA HER2-negativo mama metastática. Adjuvant olaparib (olimpiA) para HER2-negativo de alto riesgo seno temprano gBRCA.
: Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation O: : Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation OR broader HRR pathway alteration (ATM, CDK12, PALB2, etc.) — predicts PARPi response; opens olaparib/talazoparib indication in mCRPC.
: HCV RNA PCR mandatory at SMZL diagnosi: : PCR de ARN del VHC obligatorio en el diagnóstico de SMZL — SMZL impulsado por el VHC responde a antivirales de acción directa (DAA) con regresión en 50-75%; rituximab aplazado hasta la respuesta antiviral evaluada.
: HER2 (ERBB2) activating exon-20 mutati: : HER2 (ERBB2) activando la mutación exon-20 en el adenocarcinoma NSCLC — prevalencia ~2-3%; distinta de la amplificación o sobreexpresión HER2. Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd; DESTINY-Lung01/02 — ORR 49-58%) es el ADC objetivo aprobado por la FDA 2L+. HER2-amp / IHC-sólo NSCLC tiene datos de respuesta T-DXd más débiles — la mutación del dominio de quinasa es el mejor biomarcador predictivo.
: HER2 amplification / overexpression in: : amplificación / sobreexpresión de HER2 en el cáncer de mama (IHC 3+ O IHC 2+ con amplificación de ISH) — ~15-20% de mama invasiva. Define la vía de tratamiento HER2 positivo: trastuzumab + pertuzumab + quimioterapia (CLEOPATRA 1L), T-DXd 2L (DESTINY-Breast03 — mPFS 28,8 vs 6,8 mo vs T-DM1).
: HER2-low breast cancer (IHC 1+ OR IHC: : HER2-low breast cancer (IHC 1+ OR IHC 2+ with non-amplified ISH) — ~50-55% of HER2-non-positive breast cancers. T-DXd 2L+ approved in HR+ and TNBC HER2-low post-chemo (DESTINY-Breast04 — mPFS 9.9 vs 5.1 mo, OS 23.4 vs 16.8 mo).
: IDH1 R132 mutation in intrahepatic cho: : IDH1 R132 mutación en el colangiocarcinoma intrahepático después de la progresión gemcitabine/cisplatin- Terapia basada. Rutas 2L revisión de la terapia dirigida hacia ivosidenib.
: IDH2 R140Q or R172K activating mutatio: : IDH2 R140Q or R172K activating mutation in AML — ~8-12% prevalence. Enasidenib (IDHIFA / IDHENTIFY — phase-3 R/R AML; monotherapy ORR 38%, CR 19%) is FDA-approved for R/R-AML-IDH2; also active 1L combination with azacitidine in unfit (AG221-AML-005 — ORR 71%).
: IMDC (International Metastatic RCC Dat: : IMDC (Consorcio Internacional de Base de Datos de CCR metastásicos) puntuación de riesgo intermedia o pobre en CCR metastásico de células claras (Heng JCO 2009). Seis factores adversos: KPS < 80%, tiempo desde el diagnóstico hasta la terapia sistémica < 1 año, hemoglobina < límite inferior de normalidad (12 g/dL), calcio corregido > ULN, neutrófilos > ULN, plaquetas > ULN 0 factores = favorables; 1-2 = intermedio; ≥3 = pobre. CheckMate-214 (Motzer NEJM 2018) estableció la superioridad de nivolumab + ipilimumab sobre sunitinib para subgrupos de riesgo intermedio y de riesgo pobre (mOS 47 vs 26 mo, ITT). KEYNOTE-426 (pembro+axi) beneficia a todos los grupos de riesgo; nivo+ipi preferido en int/pobre por señal de respuesta duradera a largo plazo. Rutas ALGO-RCC-METASTATIC-1L paso 1 a IND-RCC-METASTATIC-1L-NIVO-IPI; riesgo favorable cae a través de IND-RCC-METASTATIC-1L-PEMBRO-AXI por defecto.
: Ifosfamide contraindicated or high-ris: : Ifosfamide contraindicated or high-risk in relapsed/refractory Burkitt lymphoma 2L salvage, routing to R-DHAP (cisplatin-based) over R-ICE (ifosfamide-based). Three clinical scenarios: (1) Prior hemorrhagic cystitis — any prior ifosfamide- or cyclophosphamide-related hemorrhagic cystitis is a contraindication to further ifosfamide even with mesna; residual mucosal damage increases bleeding risk; (2) Pelvic RT field overlap — prior irradiation to bladder field dramatically increases ifosfamide-related bladder toxicity; avoid; (3) Pre-existing peripheral neuropathy grade ≥2 — ifosfamide causes both peripheral and central neuropathy; additional neurotoxicity risk unacceptable when baseline neuropathy already impairs function; (4) Bladder outlet obstruction, single kidney, or other bladder structural contraindication to mesna- protected ifosfamide. In these scenarios R-DHAP (dexamethasone 40 mg d1-4 + cytarabine 2 g/m² q12h d2 + cisplatin 100 mg/m² d1) is the preferred platinum salvage — equivalent salvage activity to R-ICE (CORAL trial subgroup) with different toxicity profile (renal/ototoxicity from cisplatin vs bladder/neuropathy from ifosfamide).
: KIT activating mutation (exon 11 / 13): : mutación activadora del KIT (exón 11 / 13) en el subtipo de mucosa o melanoma acral — prevalencia ~15-20% en esos subtipos (rara en cutáneo). Imatinib (Carvajal 2013 — ORR 23% en mucosa/acra KIT-mut) y nilotinib son activos fuera de la etiqueta; integrar con IO estándar si son elegibles.
: KMT2A rearrangement (MLL fusion at 11q: : KMT2A rearrangement (MLL fusion at 11q23) in AML — ~5-10% prevalence in adult AML; ELN-2022 adverse-risk classifier. Revumenib (menin inhibitor; AUGMENT-101 phase 1/2) FDA-approved Nov 2024 for relapsed/ refractory KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia after ≥1 prior line (ORR ~63%, CR/CRh ~23%). Ziftomenib alternative menin inhibitor in late-phase trials. Common partners: AF9 (t(9;11)) and AF4 (t(4;11)).
: KRAS G12C mutation — ~13% of NSCLC ade: : mutación de KRAS G12C — ~13% de adenocarcinoma NSCLC; asociado al tabaquismo. Sotorasib (CodeBreaK 200 — mPFS 5,6 vs 4,5 mo docetaxel) y adagrasib (KRYSTAL-1) son inhibidores covalentes de G12C aprobados por la FDA 2L+. 1L sigue siendo IO ± quimioterapia por PD-L1 (no 1L superioridad inhibidora de G12C todavía).
: MDS with TP53 mutation (mono- or biall: : MDS with TP53 mutation (mono- or biallelic) — distinct WHO 5th-ed entity with poor outcomes on HMA monotherapy and reduced alloHCT benefit; consideration of intensified / experimental therapy or palliative intent
: MDS with isolated del(5q) (or del(5q): : MDS with isolated del(5q) (or del(5q) plus one additional non-7 abnormality) — lenalidomide-responsive subgroup with ~67% RBC transfusion independence; favorable prognosis
: MET exon 14 skipping — ~3-4% of NSCLC: : MET exon 14 saltando — ~3-4% de NSCLC adenocarcinoma; más viejo / fumador enriquecido. Capmatinib (GEOMETRY mono-1 — ORR 41-68%) y tepotinib (VISIÓN) son MET-TKI selectivos aprobados por la FDA para cualquier uso de línea. RNA-NGS preferido para la detección de empalme-sitio.
: MF with B2 blood involvement (Sézary c: : MF con afectación sanguínea B2 (cuento de células sézaras ≥1000/μL OR ≥5% Sézary por morfología) - define síndrome de Sézary / estadio de IVA1; rutas a la terapia sistémica con preferencia mogamulizumab
: MF with large-cell transformation (LCT: : MF with large-cell transformation (LCT — ≥25% large cells on biopsy review) — aggressive variant; mandates systemic therapy reassessment, brentuximab vedotin if CD30+
: MSI-high / dMMR mCRC — treatment-defin: : MSI-high / dMMR mCRC — biomarcador definidor del tratamiento. KEYNOTE-177 estableció pembrolizumab 1L sobre FOLFOX+bev (PFS 16,5 vs 8,2 mo). Esta RF se intensifica hacia la pista de inmunoterapia y anula el algoritmo quimioterapéutico predeterminado impulsado por RAS/BRAF.
: MYC + BCL2 (and/or BCL6) rearrangement: : MYC + BCL2 (and/or BCL6) rearrangement (double-/triple-hit) confirmed by FISH — DA-EPOCH-R + IT methotrexate prophylaxis preferred over R-CHOP per multiple retrospective and small prospective series.
: MYD88 L265P is the hallmark mutation o: : MYD88 L265P is the hallmark mutation of Waldenström macroglobulinemia, present in >90% of WM. Drives constitutive NF-κB activation through BTK. iNNOVATE (Dimopoulos NEJM 2018) and the iNNOVATE long-term follow-up established ibrutinib + rituximab > placebo + rituximab regardless of prior therapy; MYD88-L265P-positive disease has the highest response rate to BTKi monotherapy (ORR ~90%, major-response ~70%) while MYD88-WT WM responds poorly. Routes 1L symptomatic WM with MYD88-L265P toward BTKi-based therapy (ibrutinib, zanubrutinib per ASPEN, or ibrutinib + rituximab) over DRC chemoimmuno when chemo-avoidance is preferred (cardiac, frailty, hyperviscosity-controlled).
: Mantle cell lymphoma with MIPI low ris: : Linfoma de células del manto con IPI de bajo riesgo (IPMI <5,7 / 0-3 puntos simplificados) - apoya la inducción intensificada estándar en pacientes más jóvenes en ajuste (basado en el Nórdico / R-DHAP) sin mayor escalada del tratamiento
: Mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid / p: : Linfoma de células del manto con morfología blastoide / pleomórfica OR mutación TP53 OR del(17p) — variante agresiva resistente a quimioinmuno; ruta directamente a la terapia basada en BTKi
: Metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor prop: : Metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor proportion score (TPS) ≥50% by 22C3 IHC, no actionable driver mutations (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/NTRK/ KRAS-G12C/HER2 wild-type or unselected). KEYNOTE-024 (Reck NEJM 2016; 5-year update Reck JCO 2021) established pembrolizumab monotherapy 1L over platinum-doublet chemo for TPS ≥50% (mOS 26.3 vs 13.4 mo, 5y OS 31.9% vs 16.3%). FDA-approved 2016. Atezolizumab (IMpower-110) and cemiplimab (EMPOWER-Lung-1) similarly approved. ESMO/NCCN 2024 prefer pembrolizumab monotherapy 1L for TPS ≥50% over chemo + IO combinations (KEYNOTE-189 / -407) when patient is fit and the TPS-50% determination is reliable.
: Metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS: : Metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS wild-type status: KRAS exon 2 (codons 12, 13), exon 3 (codons 59, 61), exon 4 (codons 117, 146) AND NRAS exon 2/3/4 ALL wild-type by NGS or extended-RAS PCR. Defines the ~50% of mCRC eligible for anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody therapy (cetuximab, panitumumab) when combined with chemotherapy backbone. Left-sided RAS-WT mCRC particularly benefits from 1L anti-EGFR + FOLFOX/ FOLFIRI (CALGB/SWOG-80405, FIRE-3, PRIME, CRYSTAL — survival benefit driven by left-sided primaries; right-sided RAS-WT does NOT benefit and routes to bevacizumab + chemo).
: Multiple myeloma high-risk cytogenetic: : Citogenética de alto riesgo de mieloma múltiple: cualquiera de t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20), pérdida del(17p)/TP53, ganancia o amplificación de 1q21 por FISH interfase en células plasmáticas enriquecidas con CD138
: NTRK1/2/3 gene fusion — pan-tumor acti: : NTRK1/2/3 gene fusion — pan-tumor actionable driver; <1% in NSCLC. Larotrectinib (NAVIGATE — ORR 75% pan-tumor) and entrectinib (STARTRK-2) are FDA tissue-agnostic TRK inhibitors. Treatment-defining if detected.
: Oligometastatic esophagogastric adenoc: : Adenocarcinoma esofagogástrico oligometástico por OMEC-1 (Cáncer esofagogástico metástico) Consenso europeo de Delfos (Kroese et al., Eur J Cancer 2023, PMID 36947929). Definido como ≤3 lesiones metastáticas distantes que pueden ser tratadas localmente en un paciente con enfermedad primaria controlable y aptitud ECOG 0-1. Escenarios excluidos: carcinomatosis peritoneal, enfermedad leptomeníngea, >3 metástasis cerebrales. Ensayo RENAISSANCE / AIO-FLOT5 (NCT02578368) más estrecha elegibilidad: ≤1 involucramiento incurable del sistema de órganos, sin ascite, ≤1 estación retroperitoneal LN - utiliza quimio FLOT ± resección quirúrgica (gastrectomía/esofagoctomía + metástasectomía).
: PIK3CA hotspot activating mutation (E5: : PIK3CA hotspot activating mutation (E542K, E545K, H1047R/L) in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer — present in ~40% of cases. After progression on endocrine ± CDK4/6i, alpelisib + fulvestrant (SOLAR-1 — mPFS 11.0 vs 5.7 mo) or capivasertib + fulvestrant (CAPItello-291 — mPFS 7.3 vs 3.1 mo) are 2L+ targeted options.
: PMF with anemia as dominant clinical p: : FPM con anemia como problema clínico dominante (Hb <10 g/dL O transfusión-dependiente) - momelotinib preferido a ruxolitinib (ensayo MOMIMENTUM: bazo + síntoma + mejora de la Hb)
: PV or ET high-risk for thrombosis: age: : PV o ET de alto riesgo de trombosis: edad >60 O trombosis arterial / venosa previa OR (Sólo ET) JAK2 V617F + factores de riesgo CV (IPSET-trombosis alta) - desencadena citorreducción (HU 1L) además de la flebotomía basal + AAS
: Philadelphia-positive B-ALL (BCR-ABL1+: : Philadelphia-positive B-ALL (BCR-ABL1+) — TKI (imatinib/dasatinib/ponatinib) + chemotherapy is standard; Ph-like B-ALL signature requires JAK/ABL pathway-targeted addition.
: Platinum-sensitive ovarian relapse — P: : Recidiva ovárica sensible al platino — Intervalo libre de platino (PFI) > 6 meses desde la última dosis de platino hasta la recidiva. Definición del tratamiento: doblet de replatino (carbo + paclitaxel/PLD/gem) ± mantenimiento de bevacizumab. Mantenimiento de PARPi después de la respuesta si HRD positivo.
: Post-CROSS-CRT-then-esophagectomy with: : Post-CROSS-CRT-entonces-esofagoctomía con enfermedad residual — patología muestra ypT+ y/o ypN+ (sin pCR). ~70% de los pacientes CROSS caen en esta categoría. Definición del tratamiento: desplaza al paciente de la vía de resectable-1L (CROSS neoadjuvante) a nivolumab adjuvante × 1 año por CheckMate-577 (DFS 22 vs 11 mo placebo, HR 0,69). Ventana de admisibilidad: iniciar en el plazo de 4-16 semanas después de la cirugía. Aplica a tanto adenocarcinoma como histología de células escamosas.
: Progression on covalent BTK inhibitor: : Progression on covalent BTK inhibitor (ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, zanubrutinib). Triggers selection of non-covalent BTKi (pirtobrutinib), BCL2i (venetoclax-based regimens), CAR-T (lisocabtagene maraleucel, brexucabtagene autoleucel), or PI3Ki — depending on disease (CLL, MCL, WM). Resistance often driven by BTK C481S or PLCG2 mutation.
: RET fusion (KIF5B-RET, CCDC6-RET, othe: : fusión RET (KIF5B-RET, CCDC6-RET, otros) — ~1-2% de adenocarcinoma NSCLC. Selpercatinib (LIBRETTO-001 — ORR 85% TKI-naive) y pralsetinib (ARROW) son RET-TKI selectivos aprobados por la FDA; se prefiere 1L sobre multiquinasa (cabo, vandetanib).
: ROS1 fusion (CD74-ROS1, EZR-ROS1, othe: : ROS1 fusion (CD74-ROS1, EZR-ROS1, others) — ~1-2% of NSCLC adenocarcinoma; never-smoker enriched. Treatment-defining: entrectinib (CNS-active) or repotrectinib (TRIDENT-1, including post-crizotinib resistance) preferred 1L; crizotinib historic option.
: Rapid progression in CRC: relapse with: : Rapid progression in CRC: relapse within ≤6 months of completing adjuvant chemo (oxaliplatin-resistant phenotype), new peritoneal carcinomatosis with ascites + obstruction, OR rapid LDH/CEA doubling (>50% rise over 4-8 weeks). Alters 2L+ regimen choice + may contraindicate oxaliplatin re-introduction.
: Relapsed/refractory DLBCL post ≥2 prio: : Relapsed/refractory DLBCL post ≥2 prior systemic therapies, NOT a candidate for anti-CD19 CAR-T (axi-cel / liso-cel / tisa-cel) due to frailty, organ dysfunction, comorbidity burden, manufacturing-window risk, prior CAR-T failure, or absent funded referral pathway. Routes 3L+ to loncastuximab tesirine (LOTIS-2 Caimi 2021 Lancet Oncol; ORR 48%, CR 24%, mPFS 4.9 mo, mOS 9.5 mo) — off-the-shelf outpatient ADC ideally suited for non-CAR-T-eligible frail patient. Distinct from universal RF-CAR-T-INELIGIBLE-AGE-COMORBID (which gates on age ≥75 + Charlson ≥4) — this flag covers the broader DLBCL-specific ineligibility composite including UA access constraints (no funded international referral pathway).
: Resected stage III cutaneous melanoma: : Melanoma cutáneo de estadio III resecado — biología elegible para el adyuvante (biopsia positiva del nódulo centinela-linfa o enfermedad nodal clínicamente detectada, resecada quirúrgicamente mediante una amplia excisión local ± linfadenectomía completa o disección terapéutica del cuello/inguinal por juicio quirúrgico). Definición del tratamiento: desplaza al paciente de la vía metastásica de 1L a la inmunoterapia adjuvante (KEYNOTE-054 pembrolizumab × 12 meses, CheckMate-238 nivolumab × 12 meses) o adyuvante BRAFi+MEKi (COMBI-AD dabrafenib + trametinib) para los mutantes BRAF V600. Terapia adjuvante iniciada dentro de las 12 semanas siguientes a la cirugía definitiva en los ensayos de registro.
: Romidepsin inaccessible, contraindicat: : Romidepsin inaccessible, contraindicated, or intolerant in AITL 2L+. Scenarios driving ineligibility: (1) Access — romidepsin is not approved in Ukraine (as of 2026); available only via named-patient programme or clinical trial; many patients cannot access; (2) Cardiac contraindication — class I/II QTc-prolonging cardiac arrhythmia or baseline QTc ≥480 ms; romidepsin HDACi class causes dose-dependent QTc prolongation and is contraindicated in significant baseline arrhythmia; (3) Prior HDACi intolerance — prior romidepsin or belinostat-related grade ≥3 cardiac event, thrombocytopenia, or GI toxicity requiring discontinuation. In all cases belinostat (BELIEF, 2014; PTCL ORR 25.8%, AITL ORR ~46%) is the preferred alternative HDACi: less QTc prolongation than romidepsin, IV weekly schedule, and UA-accessible via named-patient. Azacitidine remains an orthogonal alternative (HMA, not HDACi) routed via step 1 default.
: Shimoyama smoldering or chronic-favour: : Subtipo de ATLL de Shimoyama o subtipo de Shimoyama favorable a la crónica. Fumación: ≥5% de linfocitos anormales circulantes, sin afectación de órganos (permitido la piel/lesión pulmonar), LDH normal, BUN normal, albúmina normal, sin hipercalcemia, sin linfadenopatía ni organomegalia. Crónico-favorable: similar a linfadenopatía/organomegalia permitida, LDH ≤2× ULN, BUN ≤ULN, albumina ≥ULN, Ca normal, sin SNC/hueso/GI/efusión. AZT+IFN-α (mecanismo anti-HTLV-1) produce un SG de 5 años ~46% vs ~20% para la quimioterapia en estos subtipos (Metaanálisis de Bazarbachi 2010, JNCI). Los subtipos agresivos (aguda/linfoma/crónico-desfavorable) NO responden a AZT+IFN — enrutar los a CHOEP+mogamulizumab a través de RF-ATLL-HIGH-RISK-BIOLOGY.
: Symptomatic CNS metastases — ICI doubl: : Metástasis sintomáticas del SNC — dobleta ICI (nivo+ipi) activas intracranealmente; BRAFi+MEKi para crisis visceral.
: T-cell lymphoma with CD30 expression ≥: : T-cell lymphoma with CD30 expression ≥10% by IHC — qualifies for brentuximab vedotin-based regimen (CHP-Bv per ECHELON-2)
: Treatment-defining biomarkers in metas: : Biomarcadores que definen el tratamiento en adenocarcinoma gástrico metastásico/GEJ: HER2+ (IHC 3+ OR 2+/ISH+) → trastuzumab+chemo TOGA / T-DXd 2L+; CLDN18,2+ (≥75% de las células tumorales con 2+ tinción membranosa) → zolbetuximab+chemo SPOTLIGHT/GLOW; MSI-H → pembrolizumab mono; subtipo EBV+ (clase molecular de TCG) — biología distinta, ICI-favorable.
: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC):: : Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): estrogen receptor (ER) <1% nuclear staining on IHC AND progesterone receptor (PR) <1% nuclear staining on IHC AND HER2-negative (IHC 0 or 1+, OR IHC 2+ with ISH non-amplified). TNBC represents ~15-20% of all invasive breast cancers and is defined by the absence of all three hormone/growth-factor receptor targets. Clinical significance: TNBC lacks ER, PR, and HER2 targets, precluding endocrine therapy (tamoxifen, aromatase inhibitors) and HER2-directed therapy. Treatment is chemotherapy-based: - Early TNBC: pembrolizumab + neoadjuvant chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-522; Schmid NEJM 2022) — pCR rate 64.8% vs 51.2% with chemo alone, regardless of PD-L1 status. KEYNOTE-522 is the standard-of-care regimen. - Metastatic TNBC (BRCA-WT): pembrolizumab + chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-355) for CPS ≥10; chemotherapy alone (nab-paclitaxel, paclitaxel, or gemcitabine+carboplatin) for CPS <10. - Metastatic TNBC + germline BRCA1/2 mutation: olaparib or talazoparib preferred 1L over chemotherapy (OlympiAD; exploits HRD). Fires to route ALGO-BREAST-1L step 3 toward the TNBC track (step 4 stage gate → PARPi or pembro+chemo routing) instead of the HR+/HER2- track (CDK4/6i+AI, step 5). The engine sequential check (step 1: HER2+ gate via RF-BREAST-HER2-AMP- ACTIONABLE; step 3: TNBC gate via this RF) means HER2-positive patients are already routed away before step 3 fires. The HER2-negative component of the TNBC definition is therefore confirmed by the prior sequential filtering, but is included in the trigger for completeness and for use in non-sequential contexts.
: Visceral organ involvement (pulmonary,: : Visceral organ involvement (pulmonary, gastrointestinal, or other visceral site) OR extensive/rapidly progressive mucocutaneous disease (widespread cutaneous lesions, tumor-associated lymphedema, or ulceration) in Kaposi sarcoma of any epidemiologic form (AIDS- associated, iatrogenic, classic, or endemic). Symptomatic/extensive disease of this kind is not expected to be adequately controlled by immune restoration (ART / immunosuppression rebalance) or local therapy alone and drives escalation to systemic chemotherapy.
: Waldenström with clinical / biochemica: : Waldenström con características clínicas / bioquímicas relativas a la transformación en DLBCL: aumento rápido de LDH, masa nodal o extranodal asimétrica / rápidamente agrandamiento, SUVmax PET-CT >10 (WM raramente PET-víd; SUV alto sobre), síntomas B en paciente previamente asintomático, o hipercalcemia. Manda biopsia urgente excisiva de lesión PET-víd.
: synthetic scenarios, actual outputs, s: : escenarios sintéticos, salidas reales, procedencia de la fuente y retroalimentación exportable.
<1.0 K/μL — engine will add G-CSF prophy: <1,0 K/μL — el motor agregará la profilaxis G-CSF.

The patient themself has NOT yet been germline-tested and has no current personal cancer diagnosis. Per autosomal-dominant inheritance, the patient carries a **50% prior probability** of also being a BRCA carrier — far higher than the ~5-10% positive yield of pedigree-only testing populations — providing strong clinical motivation for cascade germline testing. Distinct from RF-BRCA-HBOC-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION (fires on pedigree pattern alone, before any relative has tested positive) and from RF-BRCA-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (fires after the patient's own positive germline test). ABC-06 trial established FOLFOX as 2L st: ABC-06 trial established FOLFOX as 2L standard (mOS 6.2 vs 5.3 mo active symptom control); however biliary drainage (ERCP / PTBD) is prerequisite — chemotherapy on uncontrolled cholangitis is associated with rapid sepsis. Re-biopsy at progression yields actionable mutation in ~30% (FGFR2, IDH1, HER2, BRAF) per MSKCC and Mayo cohorts — changes 2L choice from FOLFOX to targeted therapy. Peritoneal carcinomatosis indicates poor prognosis (mOS <6 mo); palliative intent and early hospice consultation appropriate.
ABSOLUTE FIRST-LINE for anaphylaxis — no: ABSOLUTE FIRST-LINE for anaphylaxis — no equivalent alternative. H1/H2 antihistamines (diphenhydramine, famotidine), corticosteroids (hydrocortisone, methylprednisolone), and bronchodilators are all ADJUNCTS, NOT replacements. Delay or omission of epinephrine in anaphylaxis is the leading modifiable cause of fatal outcome — give EARLY (within 5 min of recognition), give IM thigh (NOT SC, NOT deltoid), and REPEAT every 5-15 min if symptoms persist. Common pitfall in chemotherapy infusion reactions: treating with diphenhydramine + steroid alone while withholding epinephrine for "mild" symptoms — escalate immediately if hypotension, bronchospasm, or upper airway involvement. Patients on β-blockers who develop refractory anaphylaxis: add glucagon 1-5 mg IV bolus then 5-15 µg/min infusion (bypasses β-receptor block via intracellular cAMP elevation). Auto-injectors not widely available in Ukraine — emergency department / oncology day-unit protocols should pre-position 1 mg/mL ampules + syringes and drill the IM-thigh administration. Ukraine: registered, NSZU- covered, ubiquitous.

ABVD = doxorubicin + bleomycin + vinblas: ABVD = doxorubicin + bleomycin + vinblastine + dacarbazine. In severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C, often from HL infiltration of liver / bulky abdominal disease compressing biliary tree), bleomycin (pulmonary toxicity additive risk; hepatic metabolism) and dacarbazine (significant hepatotoxicity; rare hepatic veno- occlusive syndrome) carry unacceptable risk. Modified AV (doxo + vinblastine only) preserves the two most active agents while removing the two with the worst hepatic / pulmonary safety in this setting. APC (Adenomatous Polyposis Coli) is the: APC (Adenomatous Polyposis Coli) is the gatekeeper tumor suppressor of the WNT/β-catenin pathway. APC forms the destruction complex with AXIN1/2, GSK-3β, and CK1α that phosphorylates β-catenin (CTNNB1) at exon 3 residues (S33/S37/T41/S45) targeting it for proteasomal degradation. Loss of APC → β-catenin accumulates, translocates to the nucleus, activates TCF/LEF transcription of MYC, CCND1, and pro-proliferative genes. Frequency: somatic APC mutation in ~80% of sporadic CRC (earliest event in adenoma-carcinoma sequence). Germline: FAP (familial adenomatous polyposis) — >100 adenomas, nearly 100% CRC risk by 40y without colectomy; AFAP (attenuated FAP) — fewer adenomas, later onset. Clinical relevance: APC mutation is diagnostic/prognostic context in CRC; no APC-targeted therapy approved. Surrogate: nuclear β-catenin by IHC confirms WNT pathway activation when sequencing unavailable.

Las mutaciones somáticas de la pérdida de función de APC ocurren en ~80% de los carcinomas colorrectales esporádicos (CRC) y representan el primer evento molecular en la secuencia de adenoma-carcinoma. La pérdida de APC estabiliza la β-catenina, conduciendo la transcripción constitutiva del gen objetivo del TNT (MYC, CCND1). A pesar de su ubicuidad, APC no es un objetivo terapéutico directo para la terapia sistémica en el CRC: (1) Inhibidores de la vía del WNT: inhibidores de la porcupina (WNT-974/LGK-974, RXC004) bloquean la secreción de ligandos Wnt ascendentes del CRC y están en ensayos de fase I/II en tumores impulsados por el WNT incluyendo el CRC. Los resultados iniciales muestran una actividad modesta de un agente; no hay aprobación específica del CRC. (2) Inhibidores de la tanquirasa: degradación del bloque AXIN → restaurar el complejo de destrucción a pesar de la pérdida de APC; preclínica/fase I (NVP-TNKS656, G007-LK); toxicidad de IG limitante de la dosis. (3) La pérdida de APC no predice la respuesta al anti-EGFR (cetuximab/panitumumab) en el CRC — el estado de tipo salvaje RAS/RAF determina la elegibilidad del anti-EGFR, no el estado de APC. (4) MSI-H/dMMR CRC (~15%) co-ocurre frecuentemente con mutación somática de APC; la inmunoterapia (pembrolizumab 1L o 2L) es accionable a través del MMR deficie...

AR (androgen receptor) gene amplification detected on tumor or ctDNA NGS in mCRPC — INFORMATIONAL signal of mechanistic ARSI resistance. AR amplification is one of the most common acquired resistance mechanisms to abiraterone / enzalutamide / apalutamide / darolutamide; detected in ~30-50% of post-ARSI mCRPC ctDNA samples. AR-amp argues against ARSI-after-ARSI sequencing (limited cross-class benefit) and for early switch to taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 (if PSMA-PET-positive). FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-amp status — surfaces in MDT brief to flag patients in whom further ARSI escalation is unlikely to add benefit. AR amplification is one of three dominan: AR amplification is one of three dominant AR-pathway-driven ARSI-resistance mechanisms in mCRPC (alongside AR-V7 splice variant and AR ligand-binding- domain mutations). High-level AR-amp (ctDNA CN ≥2.5 by Guardant360, or tissue NGS CN ≥4) is detectable in 30-50% of mCRPC progressing on abiraterone or enzalutamide and correlates with shorter PFS/OS on continued ARSI. Distinct from AR-V7 (splice variant — see BIO-AR-V7): AR-amp = wild-type-AR overexpression (still ligand-binding-domain competent; can still respond to higher-affinity ARSI in some cases), AR-V7 = constitutively-active LBD-truncated isoform (ligand-independent, ARSI cannot bind). Clinical use: ctDNA AR-CN trajectory under ARSI monitors clonal selection; rising AR-CN signals impending progression. HOWEVER: NO FDA-approved Tx decision keyed on AR-amp; guidelines (NCCN, ESMO, EAU) treat it as informational / prognostic. Use in MDT brief to flag patients at risk of ARSI-resistance and to discuss switch to taxane (docetaxel, cabazitaxel), 177Lu-PSMA-617 (PSMA-positive), or PARPi (HRR-mutated). AR-V7 is a constitutively-active splice: AR-V7 is a constitutively-active splice variant of the androgen receptor lacking the ligand-binding domain. Detected most commonly on circulating tumor cells (CTCs) by Epic AR-V7 Nucleus Detect IHC. Clinical relevance in mCRPC: AR-V7-positive patients have markedly inferior PFS/OS on abiraterone or enzalutamide compared to AR-V7-negative (PROPHECY, Antonarakis 2019, J Clin Oncol — HR ~3 for inferior survival). Switch to taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) recovers responses. HOWEVER: FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-V7; guidelines treat it as investigational / informational. Use in MDT brief to flag patients in whom ARSI-after-ARSI is unlikely to work and for whom a switch to taxane (or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 if PSMA-positive) should be discussed. KB scope choice: AR-V7 ships as biomarker + RF (informational) only — no new IND, no algorithm step in this chunk. Tx-modifying signal ("switch ARSI → taxane") would require a new taxane-mCRPC IND branched on AR-V7, which is deferred.

AXIN2 germline pathogenic variants cause: AXIN2 germline pathogenic variants cause a Lynch-like attenuated polyposis + oligodontia syndrome (Lammi et al. 2004) — characterized by congenital absence of multiple permanent teeth (oligodontia, often >6 teeth), early- onset adenomas, attenuated polyposis (typically <100 adenomas), and elevated colorectal cancer risk. AXIN2 is a WNT-pathway tumor suppressor; loss stabilizes β-catenin. Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol follows attenuated FAP / Lynch-like template: colonoscopy q1-2y starting age 25 (or 10y before earliest family CRC), with polypectomy of all detected adenomas; if adenoma burden grows beyond endoscopic management, surgical consultation. Cascade testing to first-degree relatives. Oligodontia is a useful clinical flag — dental record review may identify undiagnosed carriers. ESCAT IIA.

Achalasia (primary esophageal motor disorder with impaired LES relaxation and loss of esophageal peristalsis, diagnosed by high-resolution manometry per Chicago classification) in an individual without a current esophageal cancer diagnosis. Long-standing chronic food stasis and esophagitis confer markedly elevated esophageal SCC risk (relative risk ~16-50x population baseline; absolute risk ~0.3-1%/year emerging 10-25 years after achalasia onset). Esophageal adenocarcinoma risk is also elevated in achalasia patients with secondary Barrett's after surgical or pneumatic myotomy. Endoscopic surveillance starting 10-15 years after achalasia diagnosis is the standard secondary-prevention strategy. Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 ratification 2026-05-18, v0.3 chronic-condition pilot).

Acquired in ~30–40% of HR+ HER2− metasta: Adquirido en ~30–40% de HR+ HER2− progresión metastática de la mama en inhibidor de aromatasa; <1% en tumores primarios al momento del diagnóstico. Predictivo para el elacestrant (ensayo de SERD oral; EMERALD - beneficio de PFS limitado a subgrupo de ESR1-mut). Prueba sobre ctDNA a la progresión en IA ± CDK4/6i. Otros SERD orales (camizestrant, gireestrant, imunestrant) y PROTACs en desarrollo tardío. Y537S confiere biología más agresiva que D538G en algunas series. ctDNA es el espécimen preferido porque las mutaciones ESR1 son típicamente subclonales en el tejido y frecuentemente policlonales a través de sitios metastásicos.
Acquired in ~50-60% of patients progress: Adquirido en ~50-60% de los pacientes progresando en 1a/2a generación de EGFR-TKI. Por AURA3 (Mok 2017), osimertinib duplica PFS vs platino/ pemetrexed en T790M+. También puede ocurrir de novo (raro; ~1%) — típicamente germinal. ctDNA "biopsia líquida" de primera línea por NCCN a la resistencia adquirida, con confirmación del tejido si negativa.
Acquired resistance mutation to 3rd-gene: Acquired resistance mutation to 3rd-generation EGFR-TKI (osimertinib) — the C797 cysteine is the covalent-binding residue for osimertinib, so C797S abolishes irreversible inhibition. Most common osimertinib- resistance EGFR-on-target alteration (~7-22% of post-osimertinib re-biopsies). Triggers ESCAT IB pathway: amivantamab + lazertinib per MARIPOSA-2 (Passaro 2024). Cis vs trans T790M+C797S configuration matters: trans (different alleles) may respond to combo of 3rd-gen + 1st/2nd-gen EGFR-TKI; cis (same allele) is fully resistant to all current EGFR-TKI monotherapy and requires bypass strategy (amivantamab-based, chemo, or trial enrollment).
Acquired resistance to 1st-gen TRK inhib: Acquired resistance to 1st-gen TRK inhibitors typically emerges via on-target kinase-domain mutations (G595R for NTRK1, G623R for NTRK3, solvent-front and gatekeeper variants) within 12-24 months; off-target bypass via MAPK signaling described. Selitrectinib (LOXO-195) and repotrectinib (TPX-0005) are 2nd-gen designed to overcome these mutations — TRIDENT-1 enrolled pediatric with promising responses in TRK-resistant. Salvage cytotoxic (VAC, Ewing-like VDC/IE) reasonable if 2nd-gen unavailable. Re-biopsy at progression strongly recommended.
Acquired resistance to dabrafenib + tram: Resistencia adquirida al dabrafenib + trametinib en el ATC mutante BRAF (reactivación secundaria BRAF / MEK / RAS / MAPK, mutaciones NRAS o KRAS, amplificación BRAF), progresión local rápida en TRC citotóxica, nuevas metástasis distantes (pulmón, hueso, cerebro), o transformación del cáncer de tiroides diferenciado (CTD) en componente ATC (evento de desdiferenciación) — desencadena la reestablecimiento, rebiopsia, inmunoterapia de rescate (pembrolizumab o pembrolizumab + lenvatinib) o inscripción en ensayo.

Active carcinoid syndrome in a patient with metastatic or unresectable GI-NET (or other serotonin-secreting NET). Defined clinically by any of: episodic flushing, secretory diarrhea (≥4 loose stools/day), bronchoconstriction, or elevated 24h urinary 5-HIAA / serum serotonin. Carcinoid syndrome mandates SSA therapy for symptom control regardless of antiproliferative intent; SSA is also the antiproliferative standard (CLARINET, PROMID).
Active in pre-chemotherapy and post-doce: Activo en la pre-quimioterapia y post-docetaxel MCRPC. CNS penetración > apalutamide / darolutamide; EAs cognitivas más comunes en ancianos.
Active infection at diagnosis is common: Active infection at diagnosis is common in HCL (severe neutropenia from disease itself). Standard practice: control infection first (G-CSF + antibiotics), then start cladribine. Hold-direction surfaces in MDT brief but doesn't shift Indication.
Active or latent HBV without antiviral p: Active or latent HBV without antiviral prophylaxis is an absolute contraindication to starting B-cell-depleting / immunomodulatory monoclonal antibody therapy (anti-CD20, anti-CD30 ADC, anti-CD38). Severe HBV reactivation hepatitis risk including fulminant hepatic failure.

Adrenocortical carcinoma is an aggressiv: Adrenocortical carcinoma is an aggressive rare cancer of the adrenal cortex. Bimodal age distribution (pediatric and adult peaks) reflects two distinct biological contexts: pediatric ACC is overwhelmingly hereditary (Li-Fraumeni / Beckwith-Wiedemann), adult ACC is mostly sporadic with ~10% hereditary component. Functional ACC presents with hormonal syndromes: hypercortisolism (Cushing — most common, ~50% of functional ACC), virilization (androgen-secreting; especially in women), feminization (estrogen- secreting; rare; in men), Conn syndrome (aldosterone-secreting; rare). Non-functional ACC presents with mass effect, abdominal pain, or as incidental imaging finding. Staging: ENSAT (European Network for the Study of Adrenal Tumors) staging system; tumor size >6 cm, capsular invasion, regional nodes, distant metastasis are key prognostic factors. Mitotic count (Weiss score / Helsinki score) drives recurrence-risk stratification. Treatment fundamentals (full Indications pending): radical adrenalectomy with curative intent for resectable disease — open approach historically preferred (laparoscopic associated with positive-margin / peritoneal-seeding risk in retrospective series). Adult GCT is defined molecularly by the: Adult GCT is defined molecularly by the FOXL2 p.C134W mutation (present in ~97% of cases), which is the only pathognomonic molecular alteration in any solid tumor. FOXL2 is a granulosa cell transcription factor; the C134W mutation is a dominant-negative gain-of-function that prevents normal granulosa cell differentiation. Clinically, tumors present with estrogen excess (abnormal uterine bleeding, endometrial pathology) or abdominal mass. Prognosis is generally favorable for stage I (90% 10-yr OS) but late recurrences (10–20 years) are characteristic. No FDA-approved targeted therapy as of 2026; FOXL2 inhibition and CDK4/6 inhibitors are in clinical trials. FOXL2 mutation testing is diagnostic, not therapeutic selection (ESCAT IIB — clinical utility as diagnostic/prognostic marker).

NCCN/ESMO 2024 favorecen la adición de nivolumab a FOLFOX/XELOX para CPS ≥1 (con mayor preferencia en CPS ≥5).

After progression on THP the canonical 2: After progression on THP the canonical 2L option in the OpenOnco model is trastuzumab deruxtecan (DESTINY-Breast03). Patients with active CNS metastases — particularly progression after IO/HER2-directed therapy — pull tucatinib + trastuzumab + capecitabine into the conversation because the HER2CLIMB trial demonstrated CNS activity. Germline BRCA1/2 status brings PARP-inhibitor reasoning into the longer sequencing arc but does not displace the HER2-directed backbone at any line.
After progression on the first mCRPC lin: Tras la progresión en la primera línea de la MCRPC, el capítulo espera que el alumno pese cabazitaxel, Lu-177-PSMA y radio-223 contra el otro. CARD estableció cabazitaxel después de la exposición secuencial ARPI + docetaxel. Lu-177-PSMA requiere enfermedad positiva PSMA-PET y exposición previa al taxano / ARPI por VISION. Radium-223 está reservado para la enfermedad sintomática predominante ósea sin metástasis viscerales (ALSYMPCA). El modelo OpenOnco se presenta como una opción paralela y utiliza banderas rojas (carga visceral, transformación, reserva de médula) para estrechar la elección.
After response to platinum, OpenOnco rou: After response to platinum, OpenOnco routes maintenance choices by combined BRCA / HRD status. BRCA-mutant disease (germline or somatic) routes to olaparib maintenance as the canonical first option (SOLO-1). HRD-positive non-BRCA disease pulls niraparib (PRIMA) and olaparib combinations into the conversation, often with bevacizumab continued from induction. HRD-negative disease without BRCA mutation typically relies on bevacizumab maintenance or observation; the chapter is explicit that adding a PARP inhibitor to HRD-negative non-BRCA disease is not the canonical default.

Aggressive soft-tissue sarcoma arising f: Aggressive soft-tissue sarcoma arising from peripheral nerve sheath Schwann cells. Most surgically treatable when diagnosed early; once metastatic, systemic options are limited. Standard treatment: - Localized: wide en-bloc surgical resection ± adjuvant RT. Chemotherapy (doxorubicin + ifosfamide) for high-grade per soft- tissue sarcoma protocols; benefit modest. - Metastatic: doxorubicin ± ifosfamide (1L); pazopanib (PALETTE); trabectedin / eribulin in later lines. Targeted-therapy investigational signals (no FDA approval to date for MPNST specifically): - MEK inhibitors (selumetinib, mirdametinib): rationale from NF1 → loss of neurofibromin → unrestrained RAS → MAPK; trials ongoing in NF1-related MPNST. Selumetinib is FDA-approved for NF1-associated symptomatic inoperable plexiform NEUROFIBROMA (SPRINT trial) — the pre-malignant precursor — but not yet for MPNST proper. - SHP2 inhibitors: investigational. - CDK4/6 inhibitors (CDKN2A loss → synthetic-lethality hypothesis): investigational. - Mirdametinib + selumetinib + similar agents being studied in NF1 consortia for atypical neurofibroma → MPNST transition. Among the most lethal solid tumors histo: Among the most lethal solid tumors historically — IVC by AJCC at diagnosis (any T any N M0/M1 = stage IVA/B/C). Median OS without targeted therapy 3-6 months; rapid airway compromise common. Time-critical workup: BRAF V600E status drives first-line systemic therapy and must be available within days, not weeks. ATA 2021 guideline mandates rapid IHC (VE1 antibody) + reflex sequencing. Therapy by genotype: - BRAF V600E mutant (~25–40%): dabrafenib + trametinib (ROAR basket trial — ORR ~56%, transformative); FDA approved 2018 for ATC. Often used as neoadjuvant induction → surgery → adjuvant chemoRT. - BRAF wild-type RAS / NTRK / RET targetable: selpercatinib / pralsetinib / larotrectinib / entrectinib per genotype. - BRAF/RAS/NTRK/RET wild-type: chemo-radiation (paclitaxel + RT or docetaxel + doxorubicin + RT); pembrolizumab if PD-L1+ or TMB-H. Tracheostomy decision is patient-/family-driven; some protocols defer to systemic-therapy response over upfront tracheostomy when BRAF-mutant.

La hormona anti-mülleriana (AMH) refleja el tamaño del folículo folicular primordial y es el mejor biomarcador único de la reserva ovárica. En la población portadora de BRCA1/2, AMH se utiliza como APOYO DECISIÓN para reducir el riesgo de salpingooforectomía (RSSO / BSO) tiempo, orientación de fertilidad y planificación de criopreservación de ovocitos — NO como prueba de detección para el cáncer de ovario. NCCN Genética/Familial Seno/Ovario 2025 recomienda BSO a la edad 35-40 (BRCA1) / 40-45 (BRCA2) después de completar la gestación. AMH es una entrada que informa el costo/beneficio personalizado de la criopreservación de ovocitos pre-BSO y las decisiones de reemplazo de la hormona menopáusica post-BSO. AMH NO predice el riesgo de cáncer de ovario y NO sustituye la recomendación de BSO basada en la mutación germinativa. ESCAT X — AMH no impulsa la selección del tratamiento del cáncer; clasificado como soporte de asesoramiento reproductivo.

Authored as a separate disease from ET (: Autorizado como una enfermedad separada de ET (en lugar de una sola YAML combinada de PV-ET). Racionalidad (por mensaje de commit de expansión mieloide): la prevalencia de JAK2 V617F es esencialmente universal en PV (~95%) pero sólo ~50% en ET; los factores de riesgo trombotico difieren (Hct + masa RBC en PV vs recuento de plaquetas + JAK2 + edad en ET); 1L acciones de citoreducción HU pero PV añade flebotomía obligatoria + dosis baja de ASA basal Y ruxolitinib tiene una indicación de PV (RESPONSE) distinta de MF. ET YAML reutiliza RFs superpuestas, pero tiene su propio algoritmo. STUB — requiere la firma de co-lead clínica antes de la publicación. Expansión mieloide (heme).
Authored as composite (vs three separate: Autorizado como compuesto (vs tres biomarcadores separados) por trozo de esquema-readout: NCCN ordena estos en el mismo panel hereditario e informa de ellos juntos; 1:1:1 split crearía tres archivos casi idénticos. Si las reglas descendentes necesitan comportamiento específico del gen (probablemente para CDK12, cuya biología diverge), dividir esta entrada entonces — el compuesto es un agrupamiento v0.1, no una decisión permanente. Rastree la división en hoja de ruta si/cuando MDT lo solicita.
Authored as separate disease from PV (se: Authored as separate disease from PV (see DIS-PV.notes for rationale). Treatment: low-risk ET → ASA only (avoid in extreme thrombocytosis with acquired vWD); high-risk → HU 1L; anagrelide 2L (PT-1 trial — non-inferior on thrombosis but more arterial events + bleeding + MF progression). PreT-PMF ("prefibrotic primary myelofibrosis") is increasingly distinguished from ET on trephine — has worse prognosis and behaves more like PMF; current scope: standard ET only. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication. Myeloid expansion (heme).

Autologous T cells genetically modified: Autologous T cells genetically modified ex vivo with lentiviral vector encoding chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting CD19, with 4-1BB costimulatory domain (CD137) and CD3-zeta signaling domain. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, single IV infusion → in vivo expansion + sustained cytotoxicity against CD19+ B-cell malignancies. Approved for R/R B-ALL ≤25 years (ELIANA) and R/R DLBCL adult (JULIET).
Autologous T cells transduced with a len: Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a CAR with anti-CD19 single-chain variable fragment (FMC63), 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and CD3-zeta activation domain. Distinguishing feature is administration of a defined 1:1 ratio of CD4+ and CD8+ CAR-T cells (separately manufactured, then combined), which is hypothesized to deliver more predictable expansion kinetics and a more favorable CRS/ICANS profile vs CD28-based products. Lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning precedes a single IV infusion. Approved by FDA Feb 2021 and EMA April 2022 for relapsed/ refractory large B-cell lymphoma (TRANSCEND-NHL-001), expanded in 2022 to 2L (TRANSFORM trial), and in 2024 to relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL (TRANSCEND-CLL-004) and to relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma (TRANSCEND-FL).

Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) containing a murine anti-BCMA single-chain variable fragment (scFv), a CD8α hinge/ transmembrane region, a 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and a CD3- zeta activation domain. Recognizes B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), expressed on malignant plasma cells. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, a single IV infusion produces in vivo CAR-T expansion, peak ~7-11 days post-infusion, with sustained cytotoxicity against BCMA+ myeloma cells. First CAR-T therapy approved for multiple myeloma (FDA Mar 2021, KarMMa). Expanded to 2L+ R/R MM (KarMMa-3) in 2024 for triple-class-exposed patients.

Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that contains two BCMA-targeting heavy-chain-only variable domains (VHH) in tandem, a CD8α hinge/transmembrane region, a 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and a CD3-zeta activation domain. The bivalent VHH design improves avidity for B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), expressed on malignant plasma cells. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, a single IV infusion produces in vivo expansion + sustained cytotoxicity against BCMA+ myeloma cells. Approved by FDA Feb 2022 and EMA May 2022 for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after ≥4 prior lines (CARTITUDE-1) and expanded in 2024 to 2L+ R/R MM in lenalidomide-refractory patients (CARTITUDE-4).
Autologous T-cells engineered with anti-: Autologous T-cells engineered with anti-CD19 CAR (CD28 costim + CD3-zeta activation, identical receptor construct to axi-cel) but manufactured with a CD19-depletion step prior to transduction — reduces malignant CD19+ B-cell contamination of the apheresis product (clinically meaningful in leukemic MCL where circulating malignant cells are prominent). Following lymphodepleting conditioning, engineered cells expand in vivo, recognize CD19+ B-cells, trigger cytotoxic killing.
Autologous T-cells transduced with retro: Autologous T-cells transduced with retroviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting CD19 with CD28 costimulatory + CD3-zeta activation domains. Following lymphodepleting conditioning (fludarabine + cyclophosphamide), engineered cells expand in vivo, recognize CD19+ B-cells (malignant + normal), trigger cytotoxic killing + cytokine release. Single infusion; persistence weeks to months.

BCMA (B-cell maturation antigen, TNFRSF17) expression on plasma cells in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma — universally expressed on malignant plasma cells (>99% of MM); IHC / flow cytometric confirmation typically not required for clinical eligibility but expression-loss escape on prior BCMA-directed therapy is a known mechanism. Gates BCMA-targeting agents 4L+: teclistamab (BCMAxCD3 BiTE; MajesTEC-1 Moreau 2022 NEJM — ORR 63%, CR 39.4%, mPFS 11.3 mo, mDOR 21.6 mo), elranatamab (MagnetisMM-3), and BCMA-directed CAR-T (ide-cel KarMMa, cilta-cel CARTITUDE-1). Triple-class-exposed (TCE) refractory MM cohort. Expression-loss / antigen-escape after prior BCMA exposure is a tracked composite — re-biopsy advised before sequencing a second BCMA agent.
BCMA (B-cell maturation antigen, encoded: BCMA (B-cell maturation antigen, encoded by TNFRSF17) is universally expressed on malignant plasma cells in multiple myeloma — therapeutic target for the entire BCMA-directed class: - **BCMA × CD3 bispecifics**: teclistamab (MajesTEC-1, ORR 63% / ≥CR 39% in penta-refractory MM); elranatamab (MagnetisMM-3 — pivotal trial for elranatamab; SRC entry NOT YET INGESTED, flagged in commit body). - **BCMA CAR-T**: ciltacabtagene autoleucel (CARTITUDE-1, ORR 97% / sCR 67% in heavily pre-treated R/R MM); idecabtagene vicleucel (KarMMa, R/R MM). - **BCMA ADC**: belantamab mafodotin (DREAMM-7/8, R/R MM). Cross-disease relevance: MM is the only adult disease with BCMA-directed therapy in clinical use. BCMA+ status is assumed by histology (plasma-cell neoplasm) in clinical trials — formal IHC/flow measurement not part of standard MM workup but documented in trial eligibility logs and as reference for BCMA-loss / antigen-escape surveillance at relapse on BCMA-directed therapy. BLM germline biallelic pathogenic variants cause Bloom syndrome — autosomal-recessive disorder of replication-fork resolution (BLM RecQ helicase loss). Phenotype: severe pre- and postnatal growth restriction, characteristic facial features + sun-sensitive erythematous facial rash (telangiectatic), immunodeficiency, diabetes, and very high lifetime cancer risk with broad spectrum: leukemia (AML, ALL), lymphoma, early colorectal + gastric + skin (BCC, SCC, melanoma) + breast + GU cancers. Median age at first cancer diagnosis ~25 years; many patients develop multiple primary cancers. Confirmed-carrier (biallelic) surveillance protocol (per Bloom Syndrome Registry / Cunniff et al. 2017): strict sun protection from infancy; annual dermatology + comprehensive skin exam; complete blood count q3-6mo (leukemia surveillance); colonoscopy q1-2y starting age 12-15 with polypectomy; EGD q1-2y from age 12-15; breast MRI + mammography annual from age 18-20 in women; symptom-directed evaluation with low threshold (cancers present atypically and at all ages). Avoid ionizing radiation when possible — radiosensitivity is documented. Monoallelic (heterozygous) BLM carriers may have modestly elevated cancer risk (Ashkenazi BLM-Ash founder variant — small CRC association in some studies); standard-population screening reasonable. El modelo OpenOnco utiliza la terapia dirigida primero cuando se necesita respuesta rápida (carga tumoral alta, enfermedad sintomática, progresión que amenaza los órganos) o cuando se contraindica la IO (enfermedad autoinmune activa no controlada, trasplante de órganos reciente, disfunción inmune basal grave). El defecto en la enfermedad mutante BRAF sin estas características sigue siendo IO primero porque las respuestas de IO duraderas superan la duración del beneficio de terapia dirigida en la mayoría de las evidencias prospectivas.

Distinct binding mechanism overcomes C481-mutated resistance — primary rationale for use. Cardiac safety profile better than ibrutinib (afib ~3% vs 7-15%) but bleeding risk persists. Established precursor lesion to esophageal adenocarcinoma — annual progression rates: non-dysplastic Barrett's ~0.1-0.3%/year to EAC, low-grade dysplasia (LGD) ~0.7-2%/year, high-grade dysplasia (HGD) ~7-19%/year. Endoscopic surveillance and endoscopic eradication therapy (radiofrequency ablation, endoscopic mucosal resection) for dysplastic Barrett's substantially reduce EAC incidence and mortality. Benzothiophene SERM with mixed estrogen-: Benzothiophene SERM with mixed estrogen-receptor agonist/antagonist activity tissue-specific to tamoxifen: antagonist in breast and uterus (no endometrial agonism — lower endometrial-cancer risk than tamoxifen), agonist in bone (BMD preservation) and lipid metabolism. FDA-approved for postmenopausal osteoporosis and invasive-breast-cancer risk reduction. STAR P-2 trial established non-inferior breast-cancer-prevention efficacy vs. tamoxifen in postmenopausal women with lower endometrial-cancer and VTE risk.
Best CV safety profile of any ADT in HER: Mejor CV perfil de seguridad de cualquier ADT en HERO en el juicio (54% relativa MACE reducción vs leuprolide). UA- acceder a la barrera principal; marcado para revisión por el médico.
Best OS data among CDK4/6i in metastatic: Los mejores datos de SG entre CDK4/6i en la fase metastásica. En el ensayo NATALEE se estableció un papel adyuvante de 3 años para N+ HR+/HER2- mama precoz de alto riesgo, posible cambio estándar de cuidado.
Best safety profile of the ARPIs (no exc: Best safety profile of the ARPIs (no excess seizures, falls, cognitive AEs). Preferred for nmCRPC in elderly. ARASENS triplet (ADT + darolutamide + docetaxel) standard for high-volume mHSPC where infrastructure permits.
Best-prognosis EGFR variant — superior P: Best-prognosis EGFR variant — superior PFS vs L858R on osimertinib (FLAURA HR ~0.43 vs ~0.51). Also responds well to afatinib, dacomitinib, erlotinib, gefitinib. Most common single deletion is E746_A750 (~70% of all exon 19 deletions); other in-frame deletions E746-T751, L747-P753, etc. share TKI sensitivity. NCCN 2025: universal EGFR testing required for advanced non-squamous NSCLC.

Bibliographic record SRC-EPCORE-NHL-1-TH: Bibliographic record SRC-EPCORE-NHL-1-THIEBLEMONT-2023 is available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off. Efficacy figures cited inline reflect Thieblemont et al. J Clin Oncol 2023 41(12):2238-2247 (DOI 10.1200/JCO.22.01725). Step-up schedule: cycle 1 days 1/8/15 priming (0.16 mg → 0.8 mg → 48 mg) to mitigate CRS; full dose 48 mg SC weekly cycles 1-3, biweekly cycles 4-9, q4w cycle 10+. CRS ~50% any grade / 2.5% G3+ (mostly cycle 1); ICANS ~6% / <1% G3+. Infection G3+ ~15%; tocilizumab + dexamethasone for CRS. Sequencing post-CAR-T: epcoritamab retains activity (cohort 1B EPCORE NHL-1 ~54% ORR post-CAR-T). NOT to be used in CD20-negative escape variants — re-biopsy if late-relapse. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff.
Bibliographic record SRC-NP30179-DICKINS: Bibliographic record SRC-NP30179-DICKINSON-2022 is available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off. Efficacy figures cited inline reflect Dickinson et al. NEJM 2022 387(24):2220-2231 (DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2206913). Schedule: obinutuzumab 1000 mg IV pre-treatment day -7; step-up C1D8 2.5 mg, C1D15 10 mg, C2D1 30 mg, then 30 mg q3w cycles 2-12 (fixed 12 cycles total). CRS ~63% any grade / 4% G3+ (concentrated cycle 1); ICANS ~8% / ~3% G3+. Tocilizumab + corticosteroid for CRS. Sequencing: glofitamab activity post-CAR-T preserved; post-BiTE (epcoritamab) data emerging. Fixed-duration is operationally simpler than continuous SC dosing for low-resource settings. NOT to be used in CD20-negative escape variants — re-biopsy if late-relapse. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff.

Bicyclic depsipeptide HDAC inhibitor wit: El inhibidor de HDAC del depsipéptido bicíclico con mayor selectividad para el HDAC de clase I (HDAC1, HDAC2) - aumenta la acetilación de histona, desreprime los genes de supresor de tumores, induce apoptosis en neoplasias de células T. Especialmente activa en el PTCL con desreglamentación epigenética. Nota: La FDA aprobó inicialmente para el PTCL, pero retiró voluntariamente la indicación de PTCL en 2021 (ensayo post-comercialización Ro-CHOEP no mostró ningún beneficio de PFS sobre CHOP); la indicación de CTCL retenida. Todavía se utiliza internacionalmente según las directrices de NCCN para el PTCL r/r después de la discusión individual beneficio-riesgo.

Bifunctional alkylating agent of the nit: Agente alquilante bifuncional de la clase nitrógeno-mustard. Mostaza aromática de nitrógeno con un portador de ácido fenilbutírico; menos reactivo (y por lo tanto mejor biodisponible oralmente + menos agudo tóxico) que las mostazas de nitrógeno clásicas. Forma intermediarios de aziridinio que alquilan la posición N7 de la guanina, generando enlaces cruzados de ADN intra- e interrmand → replicación bloqueada, transcripción y apoptosis (preferencialmente en células linfoides lentas). Utilizado durante décadas en CLL (ahora en gran medida suplantado por inhibidores de BTK e BCL2), Waldenström, y como socio de obinutuzumab en CLL comorbida de ancianos (ensayo CLL11).
Bifunctional alkylating agent with a pur: Agente alquilante bifuncional con una fracción de benzimidazol parecida a la purina; induce daño al ADN y apoptosis en los linfocitos.
Biktarvy is a preferred first-line singl: Biktarvy es un régimen preferido de tratamiento antirretroviral de primera línea de un solo comprimido por DHHS / EACS / NIH AIDSinfo (2024). Combina bittegravir (inhibidor de la transferencia de la cadena de integración), emtricitabina (NRTI), tenofovir-AF (NRTI). Alta barrera genética a la resistencia, interacciones medicamentosas mínimas y bien toleradas vs. regímenes basados en PI antiguos. Recomendado para la vía de prevención del VIH-cancer (por IND-CHRONIC-HIV-PREVENTION-ART).

Binary positive/negative used for Indica: Positivo/negativo binario utilizado para la aplicabilidad de Indicación; valor cuantitativo rastreado para la evaluación de la respuesta antiviral (RVS12 = indetectable en la semana 12 después del tratamiento).
Binds CD38, which is highly expressed on: Binds CD38, which is highly expressed on plasma cells. Induces myeloma cell death through complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC), antibody- dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis (ADCP), apoptosis, and immunomodulation via depletion of CD38+ regulatory T-cells.
Binds HER2 subdomain II, blocking HER2:H: Ata el subdominio HER2 II, bloqueando la heterodimerización HER2:HER3 — mecanismo complementario al trastuzumab (que une el subdominio IV). La combinación de doble bloqueo es sinérgica.
Binds PML moiety of PML-RARα fusion → SU: Amarra la fracción PML de la fusión PML-RARα → SUMOilación, ubiquitinación y degradación proteasómica de la oncoproteína. Sinergiza con ATRA. Con ATRA, hace de APL la primera leucemia aguda curable por quimioterapia.
Binds a distinct, allosteric epitope on: Binds a distinct, allosteric epitope on CD38 (different from daratumumab's binding site) on plasma cells and other CD38+ populations. Induces myeloma cell death through complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC), antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis (ADCP), direct apoptosis (Fc-independent — distinguishes from daratumumab), and immunomodulation via depletion of CD38+ regulatory T-cells and inhibition of CD38 enzymatic activity (NAD+/cADPR axis). Cross- reactivity with daratumumab is partial — clinical activity has been observed after daratumumab failure in some patients but the two agents are treated as the same effective class for sequencing purposes (one-shot anti-CD38 line per CHARTER hierarchy).
Binds cereblon (CRBN) within the CRL4-CR: Cereblon de unión (CRBN) dentro del complejo CRL4-CRBN E3 ubiquitina ligasa, redirigirlo a factores de transcripción IKZF1 e IKZF3. Su degradación es selectivamente citotóxica para células de mieloma múltiple y tiene efectos inmunomoduladores (activación de células T y NK).
Binds hydroxyapatite in bone matrix; inh: Amarra la hidroxiapatita en la matriz ósea; inhibe la osteoclasto farnesil pirofosfato sintasa, interrumpiendo la vía del mevalonato e induciendo apoptosis osteoclasto. Reduce los eventos relacionados con el esqueleto en la enfermedad ósea del mieloma.
Binds retinoic-acid receptor α (RARα) an: Amarra el receptor retinoico-ácido α (RARα) y degrada la oncoproteína de fusión PML-RARα en APL → fuerza la diferenciación de los blastos en lugar de matar.
Binds the benzodiazepine site on GABA-A: Binds the benzodiazepine site on GABA-A receptors, increasing the frequency of chloride channel opening upon GABA binding and producing hyperpolarization of neurons in cortical, limbic, and brainstem pathways. Therapeutic effects in oncology supportive care: anticipatory chemotherapy-induced nausea/vomiting (CINV) — where conditioned anxiety triggers nausea before chemo administration — and management of acute anxiety, insomnia, and agitation in hospitalized cancer patients. Also used as an anticonvulsant for seizure rescue (high-dose chemotherapy, ifosfamide encephalopathy, CNS metastases) and as an adjunct to multi-receptor antiemetic regimens for refractory CINV. Approved by FDA September 1977.
Binds the glucocorticoid receptor; in my: Ata el receptor glucocorticoide; en las células mieloma induce apoptosis mediante la supresión de la señalización NF-κB y efectos directos en las vías celulares plasmáticas que responden a glucocorticoide. Sinérgico con inhibidores de proteasoma e IMIDs.
Binds the minor groove of DNA at guanine: Amarra el pequeño surco de ADN en la guanina N2, doblando la hélice hacia el surco mayor e induciendo la reparación de la escisión nucleotídica acoplada a la transcripción-dependiente del ADN se rompe la doble cadena. Modula el microambiente tumoral agotando los macrofagos asociados al tumor.
Binds tubulin → blocks microtubule polym: Binds tubulin → bloquea polimerización de microtubulos + husillo mitótico → arresto de metafase + apoptosis. Menos neurotóxico que vincristine, más mielotóxico.
Binds tubulin, prevents microtubule poly: Amarras tubulina, previene la polimerización de microtubulos, bloquea la formación de husillo mitótico → detiene las células en la metafase, induce apoptosis.
Binds type-I interferon receptor (IFNAR): Receptor de interferón tipo I (IFNAR), induciendo la señalización JAK-STAT → aumento de la regulación de MHC-I, actividad de células NK, polarización Th1, efecto antiproliferativo directo. En ATLL, se sinergia con zidovudina (AZT/IFN-α) induciendo apoptosis de células infectadas con HTLV-1.
Binet A (Binet 1981) = <3 involved lymph: Bienet A (Binet 1981) = <3 involucraba áreas linfoides (cervical, axilar, inguinal +/- hígado/eslofe) Y Hb ≥10 g/dL Y plt ≥100K. OS mediana >10 años. iwCLL 2018 + ESMO + NCCN coinciden: Bienet A sin criterios de enfermedad activa (citopenia progresiva, linfadenopatía voluminosa/sintomática, duplicación de linfocitos <6 mo, citopenia autoinmune refractaria a esteroides, síntomas B) NO cumple la indicación del tratamiento. CLL12 (Langerbeins 2019) mostró ibrutinib en monoterapia en Binet Una SFE mejorada de alto riesgo genético, pero no SG, el tratamiento inicial en la etapa A sigue siendo atípico fuera de los ensayos.
Binet B = ≥3 lymphoid areas, no cytopeni: Bienet B = ≥3 áreas linfoides, sin citopenia, mediana OS ~5-7 años. Bienet C = anemia (Hb < 10) o trombocitopenia (plt < 100K) debido a infiltración de médula, mediana OS ~2-3 años sin terapia dirigida moderna. iwCLL 2018 criterios de enfermedad activa se cumplen por Binet C y por Binet B progresivo; apoya el paso a la terapia sistémica. 1L opciones por CLL14 (ven+G fijo 12 mo), iLLUMINATO (ibrutinib+G), ELEVATE-TN (acalabrutinib +/- G), SEQUOIA (zanubrutinib). La dirección sólo se intensifica en relación con la línea de referencia de Binet A.
