Esquema de dosificación incremental (1 mg → 2 mg → 60 mg → 30 mg) mitiga el SRC de primer ciclo limitando la activación inicial de células T. Limita el tiempo (8 ciclos o hasta CR).
Bispecific antibody construct (half-life: Construcción de anticuerpos biespecíficos (formato BiTE de media vida extendido, andamio IgG-like) ligante delta-como ligante 3 (DLL3) en células tumorales de cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas Y CD3ε en células T, formando una sinapsa inmunológica redireccionada por tumor que activa la matanza de células T citotóxicas policlonales de células tumorales que expresan DLL3. DLL3 es un inhibidor Notch ligando aberrantemente expresado en la superficie de ~85-95% de los tumores SCLC, pero mínimamente en los tejidos normales, convirtiéndolo en un objetivo selectivo del tumor. Distinto del blinatumomab (anti-CD19 × CD3 BiTE para B-ALL) en: (1) diana de tumor sólido (DLL3 en SCLC) vs hematológica; (2) semivida más larga (~Fc-extendida) permitiendo la dosificación de bolo q2w IV en lugar de la perfusión continua; (3) requiere una dosis acelerada (1 mg ciclo 1 día 1) con monitorización hospitalaria para mitigar el síndrome de liberación de citocinas (SRC). No requiere pruebas DLL3 previas al tratamiento para el uso en la etiqueta — la mayoría de SCLCs son DLL3-positiv...
Bispecific single-chain antibody constru: Construcción biespecífica de anticuerpos de cadena única que unen CD19 a las neoplasias de células B y CD3 a las células T, formando una sinapsa inmunológica que activa la muerte de células T citotóxicas policlonales de las blastas de CD19+. Primera de la clase BiTE. Aprobado para MRD+ B-ALL post-inducción (ensayo BLAST) y R/R Ph- y Ph+ B-ALL.

Blastoid or pleomorphic histologic variant of mantle cell lymphoma — ~10-15% of MCL at diagnosis, biology aggressive (Ki-67 typically >50%, often co-mutated TP53/CDKN2A), poor response to chemoimmunotherapy (BR, R-CHOP, R-DHAP) with median OS <2 years on cBTKi. ZUMA-2 (Wang NEJM 2020) established brexucabtagene autoleucel (KTE-X19) for R/R MCL post-cBTKi (ORR 91%, CR 68%, mPFS not reached at 24 mo). Routes blastoid/pleomorphic MCL to CAR-T prioritization at 2L (post-cBTKi or post-chemoimmuno failure) over alloHCT or further chemoimmuno.
Blastoid/pleomorphic + TP53-mutant MCL h: Blastoide/pleomórfico + TP53-mutante MCL tiene una respuesta pobre a la quimioinmuno (BR/R-CHOP/R-DHAP) - impacto de supervivencia sustancial. Ruta directa a base de BTKi (acalabrutinib + rituximab; consolidación con allo-SCT o CAR-T en la progresión).
Blastoid/pleomorphic morphology + TP53 a: Blastoid/pleomorphic morphology + TP53 acquisition often co-occur and predict chemoimmuno-resistance. Distinct from RF-MCL-BLASTOID-OR-TP53 (which captures these features at diagnosis as biology) — this RF triggers when morphologic conversion / refractoriness emerges during or after 1L therapy. Brexucabtagene autoleucel (ZUMA-2 — Wang NEJM 2020) ORR 87%, CR 62% in r/r MCL post-BTKi; preferred consolidation for chemo-refractory. BTKi + venetoclax + obinutuzumab (BOVen) per Le Gouill ASH 2021 highly active in TP53-mut. AlloHCT remains curative-intent option in young fit r/r MCL.

Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity is dose-dep: Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity is dose-dependent (cumulative >270 IU) and risk-elevated by baseline DLCO <60%, age >40, smoking, prior thoracic RT, renal dysfunction. RATHL trial (Johnson 2016) established PET2-negative-then-AVD safety, halving bleomycin exposure without PFS loss. For autoSCT conditioning: BEAM (BCNU 300 mg/m²) carries 10-20% pneumonitis at DLCO <60% — substitute LEAM (lomustine) or BeEAM (bendamustine) per institutional preference. For ICI: prior pneumonitis grade ≥2 contraindicates rechallenge.

Branched tricyclic glycopeptide that bin: Branched tricyclic glycopeptide that binds the D-alanyl-D-alanine terminus of pentapeptide cell-wall precursors, sterically blocking transpeptidation and transglycosylation steps in bacterial cell- wall synthesis. Bactericidal against most Gram-positive cocci and bacilli including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), coagulase-negative staphylococci (most), ampicillin- resistant enterococci (Enterococcus faecium and faecalis except VRE), Streptococcus pneumoniae (including penicillin-resistant), and most anaerobic Gram-positives (Clostridioides difficile via oral route). No Gram-negative activity. FDA-approved 1958. In febrile neutropenia (FN), added to pip-tazo / cefepime / meropenem when MRSA is suspected (catheter-related infection, skin/soft-tissue source, prior MRSA colonization, hemodynamic instability, pneumonia with cavitation, severe mucositis with Gram-positive...
Breakthrough CINV (adult): 10-20 mg PO/I: Breakthrough CINV (adult): 10-20 mg PO/IV/IM every 4-6 hours as needed, max 30 mg/day or 0.5 mg/kg/day for routine use; total duration limited to ≤5 days per EMA / FDA restrictions to minimize tardive dyskinesia risk. High-dose CINV (historical, pre-5-HT3- antagonist era): 1-2 mg/kg IV q2h × 3-5 doses with diphenhydramine premed for EPS — now rarely used outside salvage. Renal impairment: reduce dose ~50% if CrCl <60 mL/min (renal excretion). Hepatic: caution. Pediatric: 0.1 mg/kg PO/IV q6h, max 0.5 mg/kg/day, ≤5 days. Elderly (>65 yrs): start 5 mg with extended interval (q8h); higher tardive dyskinesia risk.
Breast (weekly, dose-dense and mCa sched: Breast (weekly, dose-dense and mCa schedules): 80 mg/m² IV over 1 h weekly. Breast (every-3-weeks): 175 mg/m² IV over 3 h q21d. Ovarian 1L (with carboplatin): 175 mg/m² IV over 3 h q21d × 6. Ovarian dose-dense (Japanese GOG): 80 mg/m² weekly × 18 wks with carboplatin AUC 6 q21d × 6. NSCLC (with carbo, Bevacizumab+CP): 200 mg/m² IV q21d × 4-6. CROSS (esophageal CRT): 50 mg/m² IV weekly × 5 with carboplatin AUC 2. Mandatory premedication: dexamethasone 20 mg PO at 12 h and 6 h before, OR 20 mg IV at 30 min before; diphenhydramine 50 mg IV + H2 blocker (ranitidine 50 mg IV or famotidine 20 mg IV) at 30 min before infusion.

Breast-cancer chemoprevention (off-label: Breast-cancer chemoprevention (off-label, AI class extrapolation — NOT a guideline first-choice): 2.5 mg PO once daily for 5 years. Indicated only for POSTMENOPAUSAL women at increased breast-cancer risk who cannot receive anastrozole or exemestane (e.g., intolerance, drug-interaction profile). Baseline DEXA + lipid panel; vitamin D + calcium supplementation; bone-density re-assessment every 1-2 y. Discontinue and refer to endocrinology if osteoporotic fracture occurs. NOT effective in premenopausal women (ovarian aromatase escape).

Quimioprevención del cáncer de mama (fuera de la etiqueta, NCCN mama / NICE): 1 mg PO una vez al día durante 5 años. Indicado para las mujeres POSTMENOPAUSAL con mayor riesgo de cáncer de mama (por ejemplo, IBIS 5 años/Tyrer-Cuzick ≥3%, o ≥1,7% Gail; LCIS, hiperplasia atípica, portadores de BRCA sin cirugía, RT torácica previa). DEXA + panel de lípidos basal; suplemento de vitamina D + calcio por protocolo de salud ósea. Reimagen densidad ósea cada 1-2 años. Descontinuar y referirse a la endocrinología si se desarrolla fractura osteoporótica. Evite en mujeres premenopáusicas (ineficaz; fuga de aromatasa ovárica).

Extremely stable against most β-lactamases including ESBLs and AmpC, but hydrolyzed by carbapenemases (KPC, NDM, OXA-48, VIM, IMP). Lower seizure-risk than imipenem (no DHP-1 inhibitor needed; reduced PBP-2 affinity in CNS). FDA-approved 1996. Reserved for documented or strongly suspected MDR Gram-negative infections, severe sepsis with broad-spectrum coverage need, and FN failing initial empirical therapy at 72-96 hours.

CD22 expression on lymphoblasts in relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) — CD22 expressed on >90% B-ALL blasts; flow cytometric / IHC confirmation typically available at diagnosis. Gates inotuzumab ozogamicin (INO; anti-CD22 calicheamicin ADC) for R/R adult B-ALL. INO-VATE ALL (Kantarjian 2016 NEJM): inotuzumab vs standard chemotherapy in R/R B-ALL — CR/CRi 80.7% vs 29.4%, MRD-negative 78.4% of responders, mPFS 5.0 vs 1.8 mo, mOS 7.7 vs 6.7 mo. Bridge to alloHCT is the curative-intent goal — INO-induced remission + prompt transplant in MRD-negative responders associated with durable disease control. Distinct from blinatumomab (anti-CD19 BiTE) — alternative or sequential R/R B-ALL option. CD22-loss escape uncommon; Ph-positive B-ALL also eligible (combined with TKI).
CD22+ status (≥20% of blasts/lymphoma ce: CD22+ status (≥20% of blasts/lymphoma cells expressing CD22 by flow or IHC) is the standard eligibility threshold for inotuzumab ozogamicin (anti-CD22 calicheamicin ADC) — INO-VATE used flow ≥20% of blasts. Cross-disease relevance: - **B-ALL** (~90%+): CD22+ on virtually all B-ALL — required for inotuzumab in R/R B-ALL (INO-VATE 2L+; CR/CRi 81% vs 29% chemo). Also gates moxetumomab (HCL) and emerging CD22 CAR-T trials. - **B-cell NHL** (variable): CD22+ in CLL, MCL, FL, DLBCL — quantitative threshold matters for ADC dosing rationale; qualitative positive for diagnostic panel use. - **HCL**: CD22+ universally (target of moxetumomab). Quantitative measurement matters: weak / partial CD22 expression predicts inferior ADC response. VOD/SOS risk post-allo-HCT (~14% in INO-VATE) — pre-transplant inotuzumab dose limit. `ihc_no_variant` skip reason — protein expression target, not variant lookup.

MCD-like DLBCL: ABC subtype + chronic active BCR signaling, frequent extranodal involvement (CNS, testis, breast, skin), inferior outcome on standard R-CHOP. Targeted therapy implications: BTK inhibitor (ibrutinib) hypothesis- generated benefit (PHOENIX subgroup analysis Younes 2019 JCO in age <60 + non-GCB), polatuzumab vedotin (POLARIX subgroup analysis suggests preferential MCD benefit). El hiperparatiroidismo aislado familiar (FIHP) es una presentación superpuesta con características extraparatiroides atenuadas.Protocolo de vigilancia confirmada por portadores (per Endocrine Society Hereditary Endocrine Tumor Guideline + Marx et al.): calcio sérico anual + hormona paratiroidea (PTH) + examen físico del cuello a partir de la edad de 5-10 años; imagen de la mandíbula (panoramica / TC) a partir de la edad de 10 años para fibroma osificante; imagen renal (US ± RM) cada 5 años; imagen pélvica en mujeres por preocupación uterina-tumoral. En la cirugía paratiroidea en portadores de HPT-JT, la resección en bloc con tiroidectomía + seguimiento a lo largo de toda la vida se prefiere a la paratiroidectomía mínimamente invasiva debido al alto riesgo de carcinoma y recidiva...

TP53 mutations co-occur in high-grade — confer chemoresistance signal. NF1-associated MPNST has worse 5-yr OS (~30%) vs sporadic (~50%). Intensification: neoadjuvant AI (doxorubicin + ifosfamide) followed by R0 resection + adjuvant RT — improves limb salvage rate. Selumetinib has activity in NF1- related plexiform NF (SPRINT) but data in frank MPNST limited.

CLARINET (Caplin NEJM 2014): lanreotide 120 mg q4w vs placebo in well-differentiated G1/G2 non-functioning GEP-NET (n=204). mPFS not reached vs 18.0 mo (HR 0.47, p<0.001). Octreotide LAR 30 mg q4w is a valid alternative to lanreotide (no head-to-head; both NCCN Category 1 for GI-NET). Lanreotide used here as it has the broader CLARINET GEP-NET data set. CLEAR: lenv+pembro vs sunitinib, PFS 23.9 vs 9.2 mo (HR 0.39) — largest PFS gain in any 1L ccRCC trial. mOS HR 0.66. However, highest toxicity burden of the 1L combos: hypertension G3-4 ~36%, proteinuria G3 ~6%, fatigue ~10%. Dose reductions frequent (69% for lenvatinib). Max 2 years pembrolizumab. Lenvatinib dose starts at 20mg; reduces to 14→10→8mg for toxicity. Favored when maximal tumor response is the priority (conversion, symptomatic high-burden disease). PHESGO (HP fixed-dose SC + hyaluronidase) approved alternative — single SC injection over ~5-8 min, replaces both IV infusions; preferred for chair-time and patient convenience after initial IV doses tolerated. LVEF baseline + q3 mo.

CLL11 (Goede 2014, NEJM): G-Clb vs R-Clb: CLL11 (Goede 2014, NEJM): G-Clb vs R-Clb vs Clb monotherapy in previously-untreated CLL with comorbidities (CIRS >6 OR CrCl 30-69) — mPFS 26.7 vs 15.2 vs 11.1 mo, with G-Clb also showing OS benefit vs Clb alone. Now positioned behind venetoclax- obinutuzumab (CLL14, fixed-duration) and BTK-inhibitor monotherapy in fit comorbid patients, but G-Clb remains a reasonable fixed-duration option when targeted-agent access or tolerability is limited. CLL11 (Goede 2014, NEJM): obinutuzumab +: CLL11 (Goede 2014, NEJM): obinutuzumab + chlorambucil vs rituximab + chlorambucil vs chlorambucil alone in previously-untreated CLL with comorbidities (CIRS >6 OR CrCl 30-69) — mPFS 26.7 vs 15.2 vs 11.1 mo. Now positioned behind venetoclax-obinutuzumab and BTK-inhibitor monotherapy in most NCCN/ESMO algorithms, but remains relevant for patients without access to those agents OR with contraindications to them. Long history (since 1957) — most familiar oral chemotherapy in community haematology. Counsel on infertility and secondary-malignancy risk before initiating; consider sperm banking / oocyte cryopreservation for younger patients (uncommonly used in this age group). TLS prophylaxis (allopurinol + hydration) for high-burden disease at cycle 1.

CML patient with cardiovascular / metabolic / pulmonary comorbidity profile that constrains 2nd-generation TKI choice. Specifically: uncontrolled hypertension, prior arterial thrombotic event, QTc-prolongation risk (baseline QTc > 460 ms or QT-prolonging medications), pancreatitis history, pulmonary hypertension, or pleural-effusion-prone state. Drives selection toward asciminib (STAMP inhibitor, cleanest CV/QTc profile) over nilotinib (CV / QTc / metabolic risk), dasatinib (pleural effusion / pulmonary hypertension), or bosutinib (GI / hepatic) when 2nd-gen TKI is otherwise indicated by RF-CML-HIGH-RISK-ELTS.

Hepatitis B/C serology required before first dose.

CSF1R (CD115) is the receptor for colony: CSF1R (CD115) is the receptor for colony-stimulating factor 1 (CSF1/M-CSF) and IL-34. In TGCT (diffuse type, formerly PVNS), the predominant mechanism is CSF1 overexpression by a minority neoplastic cell population (via COL6A3-CSF1 fusion in ~50%), which recruits and drives proliferation of CSF1R-expressing macrophages and osteoclast-like giant cells constituting the bulk of the tumor mass. Pexidartinib (PLX3397) is a CSF1R/KIT/FLT3 inhibitor FDA-approved (2019) specifically for TGCT. CSF1R is also expressed broadly on tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) — multiple investigational agents target TAMs via CSF1R (emactuzumab, cabiralizumab) but none is approved for non-TGCT indications. Do not confuse with KIT (CD117) — pexidartinib inhibits both, but the TGCT approval is CSF1R pathway-driven.

CTNNB1 encodes β-catenin, a dual-functio: CTNNB1 encodes β-catenin, a dual-function protein: (1) structural (adherens junctions, E-cadherin complex); (2) transcriptional (WNT signaling effector, activating TCF/LEF target genes including MYC, CCND1). Activating mutations in exon 3 prevent destruction complex (APC/AXIN/GSK-3β/CK1) from phosphorylating β-catenin, leading to nuclear accumulation and constitutive WNT target gene activation. Key clinical contexts: (1) Endometrial cancer (EC): CTNNB1 exon 3 mutations in ~25–30%, predominantly in endometrioid histology. The TCGA molecular classification: CTNNB1 mutation is enriched in the NSMP (No Specific Molecular Profile) and POLE-ultramutated groups. Critical prognostic finding: CTNNB1 mutations, particularly in FIGO stage I-II EC, associate with L1CAM overexpression and high risk of recurrence despite low stage — this subgroup may benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy (EC-specific risk stratification per ESGO/ESMO/ESTRO 2023). CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift mutation in the C-terminal regulatory domain (e.g., S338X, R334X) in Waldenström macroglobulinemia (WM). CXCR4 WHIM-like mutations co-occur with MYD88 L265P in ~30-40% of MYD88-mutant WM and cause constitutive CXCR4 signaling via loss of the C-terminal regulatory domain. These mutations confer relative resistance to BTK inhibitor (BTKi) monotherapy — lower overall response rate and major-response rate, slower IgM decline kinetics compared to CXCR4-WT MYD88-mutant WM (Treon NEJM 2015; Castillo Blood 2020). Fires to route ALGO-WM-2L step 1 to carfilzomib-based therapy (IND-WM-2L-CARFILZOMIB-CXCR4MUT) rather than zanubrutinib BTKi monotherapy (IND-WM-2L-ZANUBRUTINIB), as BTKi efficacy is substantially attenuated in CXCR4-mutated WM. Detection: CXCR4 C-terminal sequencing by targeted PCR + Sanger or NGS panel with CXCR4 C-terminus coverage. Note: standard NGS panels frequently omit CXCR4 C-terminus; dedicated assay required. Bone marrow aspirate with CD138+ enrichment preferred for adequate WM clone representation. CXCR4 mutation testing is recommended at WM diagnosis per NCCN B-Cell Lymphomas 2025 (alongside MYD88 L265P) to guide initial therapy selection. In CXCR4-mutated patients, BTKi monotherapy response is attenuated; proteasome-inhibitor-based regimens or BR are preferred 1L per NCCN/ESMO. In 2L, carfilzomib-based regimens offer benefit in BTKi-refractory or BTKi-intolerant CXCR4-mutated WM.

Cancer-prevention research context (CPPS: Cancer-prevention research context (CPPS protocol): Calcium carbonate ~3000 mg/day = 1200 mg/day elemental calcium, divided BID-TID with meals. Frequently combined with vitamin D (400-1000 IU/day) in trials. Recommended dietary allowance (RDA) for adults: ~1000-1200 mg/day total elemental calcium (diet + supplements). Avoid exceeding 2000-2500 mg/day total (UL — upper level). Take with food (acid required for absorption); separate from iron, thyroid hormone, bisphosphonates, tetracycline / fluoroquinolone antibiotics by ≥2 hours.
Cancer-prevention research context (FAP: Cancer-prevention research context (FAP duodenal polyposis): ~4 g/day EPA (typically as 2 g BID free fatty acid or icosapent ethyl). Hypertriglyceridemia: 4 g/day (2 capsules BID 1 g each, icosapent ethyl). Take with food. Note FAP cancer-prevention dose has only RCT-trial support, not FDA labeling.
Cancer-prevention research context (PACE: Contexto de investigación sobre prevención del cáncer (protocolo PACES): Eflornitina 500 mg PO diario + sulindac 150 mg PO diariamente (combinación, no monoterapia). Mantenimiento del neuroblastoma (Iwilfin, on-label, contexto separado): Basado en peso; ~750-1500 mg/m2 PO BID — véase la etiqueta de Iwilfina. Monitorización audiométrica: riesgo de ototoxicidad; basal + audiograma periódico. CBC + LFTs periódicamente.
Cancer-prevention research context (VITA: Cancer-prevention research context (VITAL protocol): 1 g/day EPA+DHA ethyl-ester capsule (Omacor; ~460 mg EPA + 380 mg DHA). Most epidemiologic-based recommendations: 1-2 g/day total EPA+DHA from fish or supplements. Hypertriglyceridemia (on-label): 4 g/day. Take with food. Some advocate split BID dosing for tolerability. No specific cancer-prevention dose has been validated outside VITAL (null result).

Cancer-prevention research context (VITAL, AMATERASU): 1000-4000 IU PO daily. Most cancer-prevention trials used 1000-2000 IU/day (VITAL: 2000 IU/day) or 2000 IU/day with calcium 1000 mg. Repletion of deficiency (25-OH-D <20 ng/mL): 50,000 IU weekly for 6-8 weeks then maintenance. Maintenance / general supplementation: 800-2000 IU/day. Goal serum 25-OH-D: 30-50 ng/mL (75-125 nmol/L); avoid >100 ng/mL (hypervitaminosis risk).
Cancer-survivor late-effects RedFlag for: Cancer-survivor late-effects RedFlag for cumulative anthracycline ≥250 mg/m² with ≥5y post-treatment interval. Distinct from RF-IATROGENIC-ANTHRACYCLINE-CARDIO-PREVENTION (general cardio surveillance starting at treatment completion). COG-LTFU-driven echo cadence q1-5y based on dose + chest RT + age at exposure. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Cancer-survivor late-effects RedFlag for cumulative cyclophosphamide ≥7 g/m². Surveillance domains: bladder cancer (annual urinalysis + cytology, primary anchor) and t-AML/MDS (CBC q3-6mo for first 5y co-managed with RF-IATROGENIC-ALKYLATOR-TAML-PREVENTION). STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Cancer-survivor late-effects RedFlag for cumulative platinum ≥400 mg/m². Surveillance domains: cardiovascular risk modification (BP + lipid panel q1y), nephropathy (creatinine + Mg q1y), secondary AML/MDS (CBC q1y). CV risk modification is the highest-yield late-effect domain. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Cancer-survivor late-effects RedFlag for prior bleomycin exposure. Surveillance domains: pulmonary fibrosis (PFTs + chest exam), second-primary lung cancer (LDCT eligibility shift if smoking history — bleomycin + tobacco synergistic), lifelong high-FiO2 oxygen-toxicity caution. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Sobreviviente del cáncer efectos tardíos RedFlag para radioterapia craneal previa ≥5y hace. Tres dominios de vigilancia: tumores secundarios del SNC (meningioma de mayor incidencia), secuelas endocrinas (eje HP), neurocognitivas. Examen neurológico anual + panel endocrino + RMN cerebral q1-3y si sintomático por COG-LTFU. STUB pendiente de firma de dos Clínica-Co-Lead por CHARTER §6.1 dev-modo.

Cáncer-sobreviviente efectos tardíos RedFlag para radioterapia pélvica pediátrica previa ≥5y hace. Tres dominios de vigilancia: cáncer de vejiga (urotelial — anclaje primario), CRC (previa detección en 45 o 10 años post-RT), otros secundarios de campo pélvisco. UA anual + citología + cribado CRC antes por COG-LTFU + CCSS. STUB pendiente de firma de dos Clínica-Co-Lead por CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Capecitabine is contraindicated CrCl <30: Capecitabine is contraindicated CrCl <30 (renally cleared, severe toxicity risk). Oxaliplatin is hepatically cleared but has additive nephrotoxicity in pre-existing CKD; risk-benefit unfavourable in severe CKD where neuropathy is also harder to manage. sLV5FU2-Bev (simplified bolus + 46h CIVI 5-FU + leucovorin + bev) provides a reasonable backbone for mCRC in severe CKD when chemo is still desired. 5-FU is hepatically metabolised (DPD); no dose adjustment needed for renal impairment (parent and metabolites only ~5-10% renal). Bevacizumab dose reduced to 5 mg/kg q2w (vs standard 5-7.5 mg/kg q2w) to limit proteinuria worsening; close BP + UPC monitoring. DPYD pre-screening strongly recommended (CPIC).

Carboplatin + paclitaxel is widely used: Carboplatin + paclitaxel is widely used as first-line chemotherapy for advanced/recurrent adult granulosa cell tumor (AGCT), extrapolated from ovarian cancer chemotherapy practice. No large randomized trial specific to GCT. BEP (bleomycin-etoposide-cisplatin) is an alternative (especially in younger patients or when platinum-taxane sensitivity unknown). Response rates ~50–70% in recurrent disease. Surgery remains primary modality; chemo is for advanced/inoperable or chemotherapy-sensitive recurrence. Hormone-directed therapy (leuprolide, letrozole) is active in hormone receptor-positive GCT, especially for maintenance.
Carboplatin + paclitaxel remains the uni: Carboplatin + paclitaxel remains the universal cytotoxic backbone for first-line advanced ovarian cancer in the OpenOnco model. The maintenance decision is made when the patient completes induction and the platinum response is established. Patients who do not respond to platinum re-enter a different algorithm and do not benefit from PARP-inhibitor maintenance in the canonical first-line model. Bevacizumab can begin during induction and continue into maintenance — the chapter is explicit that bevacizumab and PARP inhibitors are not mutually exclusive, particularly for HRD-positive non-BRCA disease.

Targeted therapy: - IDH1 R132 mutant (~40-50% of conventional): ivosidenib has activity in advanced unresectable IDH1-mutant chondrosarcoma (Tap et al JCO 2020) — small phase 1 cohort, durable disease control; not yet FDA-approved for chondrosarcoma but used off-label. - IDH2 mutant: enasidenib in similar exploratory setting. Niche actionability — represents a small but real precision-oncology signal in a disease historically without systemic options.

Child-Pugh B is the most clinically nuan: Child-Pugh B is the most clinically nuanced hepatic-dysfunction tier — many systemic-therapy trials (atezo+bev for HCC, sorafenib) limit to Child-Pugh A or carefully selected B7. Doxorubicin: 50% reduction at bilirubin 1.5-3 mg/dL, 75% at 3-5; vincristine: 50% reduction at bilirubin 1.5-3, hold ≥3; paclitaxel: dose reduction per total bilirubin; etoposide reduce 50% at bilirubin 1.5-3. R-CHOP feasible at Child-Pugh B with vincristine substitution / dose attenuation. Sorafenib safe at Child-Pugh B7 (SHARP subgroup, GIDEON registry); avoid at B8-9. For HCC-specific dosing see RF-HCC-CHILD-PUGH-B-C.

Child-Pugh B/C: cisplatin component shou: Child-Pugh B/C: cisplatin component should be omitted or replaced; consider gemcitabine monotherapy or capecitabine. FGFR2-inhibitors (pemigatinib, futibatinib, infigratinib) require dose adjustment in hepatic impairment per FDA labels. Ivosidenib (IDH1) requires QTc monitoring + dose reduction with hepatic dysfunction. CrCl <30: cisplatin contraindicated — substitute carboplatin or omit. ABC-02 / TOPAZ-1 / KEYNOTE-966 enrolled mostly preserved hepatic function; extrapolation to Child-Pugh B requires individualized risk-benefit.
Child-Pugh C exclusion is near-universal: Child-Pugh C exclusion is near-universal across systemic-therapy trials. In HCC: only BSC or hospice referral typically; selected centers offer Y90 radioembolization in CP-C7-with-good-PS, but no systemic standard. In hematologic malignancies with secondary hepatic involvement (Hodgkin, DLBCL infiltrating liver), pre-phase prednisolone alone may improve LFTs sufficiently to allow attenuated R-CVP within 1-2 weeks — reassess after pre-phase. Direction `hold` rather than `de-escalate` because no evidence-supported attenuation guarantees safety here.

Chimeric (mouse Fv / human IgG1) monoclo: Los anticuerpos monoclonales quiméricos (ratón Fv / IgG1) que unen el dominio extracelular del receptor del factor de crecimiento epidérmico (EGFR/HER1) con alta afinidad, bloquean competitivamente la unión de los ligandos endógenos (EGF, TGF-α). Inhibe la dimerización del receptor inducida por el ligando y la señalización RAS-RAF-MAPK + PI3K-AKT. La columna vertebral de Ig G1 permite ADCC. Eficaz SOLO en el MCRC de tipo salvaje del RAS (señalización mutante KRAS / NRAS bypass EGFR); los mutantes BRAF V600E también son intrínsecamente resistentes. La ubicación primaria del tumor de lado izquierdo es un predictor positivo del beneficio (CALGB-80405, subgrupo FIRE-3).
Chimeric (mouse-human) monoclonal antibo: Chimeric (mouse-human) monoclonal antibody binding the CD20 antigen on B lymphocytes (pre-B through mature B; sparing pro-B and plasma cells). Depletes CD20+ B cells via three mechanisms: complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC, dominant in CLL), antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC, dominant in lymphoma), and direct apoptosis via CD20 cross-linking. Recovery of normal B cells takes 6-12 months after the last dose.
Chimeric IgG1 monoclonal antibody target: Chimeric IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting Claudin-18 isoform 2 (CLDN18.2), a tight-junction protein normally restricted to gastric mucosa but aberrantly retained in gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma cells. Mechanisms: ADCC (NK cell-mediated via FcγRIIIa) and CDC (complement- dependent cytotoxicity). Combined with chemotherapy backbone (mFOLFOX6 in SPOTLIGHT, CAPOX in GLOW) for 1L HER2-negative CLDN18.2-positive (≥75% of tumor cells with 2+/3+ membranous staining) metastatic gastric / GEJ adenocarcinoma.

Cholangitis typically post-stenting (~10: Colangitis típicamente post-estante (~10-20% de stents plásticos, más bajo para metálicos). Tratar con antibióticos + ajuste de drenaje; retrasar la quimioterapia hasta afebrilo + bilirrubina tendencia hacia abajo.
Cholecalciferol (D3) is hepatically hydr: Cholecalciferol (D3) is hepatically hydroxylated to 25-hydroxyvitamin D (calcidiol), the storage form measured clinically, then renally hydroxylated to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (calcitriol), the active hormone. Calcitriol binds the nuclear vitamin D receptor (VDR), modulating ~1000+ genes including those involved in cell-cycle arrest (p21, p27), apoptosis, differentiation, and innate immunity. Cancer-prevention rationale: observational ecological gradients (latitude, sunlight) and large cohort 25-OH-D associations suggest reduced incidence of colorectal, breast, and possibly other cancers at higher serum levels. VITAL RCT (Manson NEJM 2019, NCT01169259): 2000 IU/day for ~5 years did NOT reduce total invasive cancer incidence (primary endpoint), with a non-significant 17% reduction in cancer mortality.
Chondrosarcoma decision-making is domina: Chondrosarcoma decision-making is dominated by subtype + grade. Dedifferentiated (~10%) — biphasic with high-grade sarcoma component, behaves aggressively (5-yr OS ~30%) → doxorubicin + ifosfamide adjuvant by extrapolation from soft-tissue sarcoma protocols. Mesenchymal (~3–5%, young adults) — HEY1-NCOA2 fusion-positive small-round-blue-cell biology, treated like Ewing (VDC/IE protocols) — chemo-sensitive. Grade III conventional — consider adjuvant systemic therapy on trial. IDH1 R132 mutant (~40–50% of conventional) — ivosidenib has signal in advanced unresectable disease (Tap et al JCO 2020); off-label / trial. CDKN2A loss is prognostic in dedifferentiated subtype.
Chondrosarcoma metastasizes preferential: Chondrosarcoma metastasizes preferentially to lung — surveillance chest CT every 6–12 mo for ≥10 years standard. Pulmonary metastasectomy for oligometastatic disease yields long-term survival in ~30% of resected patients (extrapolated from sarcoma literature). Local recurrence post-resection rate is grade-dependent (10% grade I, 50% grade III) — re-biopsy mandatory because grade upgrade and dedifferentiation can change adjuvant strategy. Pathologic fracture requires en-bloc resection (pre-fracture curettage no longer adequate — tumor seeding through fracture hematoma). Ollier / Maffucci patients require lifetime imaging surveillance — ~25% lifetime malignant transformation risk.

La cromogranina A (CgA) es una proteína secretaria familiar de granina expresada ubicuamente en células neuroendocrinas. El síro CgA se utiliza como biomarcador de la respuesta al tumor GEP-NET y del tratamiento, y como complemento de la vigilancia portadora de MEN1 junto con hormonas específicas de la enfermedad (gastrina, insulina, glucagón, VIP). La especificidad es LOW - uso de PPI (elevación masiva falsa positiva), insuficiencia renal, insuficiencia cardíaca, gastritis atrófica y variabilidad de la plataforma de ensayo toda interpretación de confusión. Sensibilidad ~60-90% en los subtipos NET (más alto en NET funcional de pequeña bowle, más bajo en pNET / insulina). ESCAT X — CgA no conduce la selección del tratamiento de forma independiente; es una herramienta de vigilancia de tendencias solamente. NCCN NET 2025 y Endocrine Society MEN 2023 reconocen Cg A pero enfatizan sus limitaciones.

Chronic HBV (adult): 300 mg PO once dail: Chronic HBV (adult): 300 mg PO once daily with food, indefinite duration (long-term suppression). HIV-1 (adult): 300 mg PO once daily as component of combination ART. Renal adjustment required: CrCl 30-49 → 300 mg q48h; CrCl 10-29 → 300 mg q72-96h; HD → 300 mg weekly after dialysis. Pediatric (≥2 y, ≥10 kg): 8 mg/kg PO daily, max 300 mg. Continue HBV therapy long- term — abrupt discontinuation risks severe HBV reactivation / acute hepatitis flare (black-box warning).
Chronic HBV (adult, compensated liver di: VHB crónico (adulto, enfermedad hepática compensada): 25 mg PO una vez al día con alimentos, duración indefinida. VIH-1: TAF es un componente de las combinaciones de dosis fijas (por ejemplo, Biktarvy = bictegravir + emtricitabina + TAF; Genvoya; Descovy) — dosis fijada por el FDC, típicamente 25 mg TAF/día. No se puede ajustar la dosis renal de CrCl ≥15 ml/min; los pacientes con HD pueden recibir 25 mg al día después de diálisis en días de diálise. Hepático: no recomendado en cirrosis descompensada (Child-Pugh B/C — use TDF o entecavir). Interrupción brusca del tratamiento con VHB → riesgo de exacerbación aguda grave; monitorear TFTs ≥ varios meses después de la interrupción (caja negra).
Chronic HCV infection (HCV-RNA detectabl: Chronic HCV infection (HCV-RNA detectable / persistent viremia) in an individual without a current B-cell NHL diagnosis. IARC Group 1 carcinogen (HCV) — established etiological driver of indolent B-cell lymphomas (MZL, lymphoplasmacytic, splenic-MZL, low-grade DLBCL subset) and HCC. DAA-based curative antiviral therapy is the highest-leverage prevention pathway and reduces both NHL incidence and HCC incidence post-SVR12. Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 ratification 2026-05-18).

Chronic Helicobacter pylori infection (p: Chronic Helicobacter pylori infection (positive urea breath test, stool antigen, gastric biopsy histology, or stool PCR) in an individual without a current gastric malignancy diagnosis. IARC Group 1 carcinogen (H. pylori) — established etiological driver of gastric adenocarcinoma (intestinal-type primarily) and gastric MALT lymphoma. Eradication therapy reduces gastric-cancer incidence (NNT ~15 in high-incidence populations per Cochrane meta-analyses) and is curative for early-stage gastric MALT lymphoma in ~70-80% of cases (Wotherspoon regression). Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 ratification 2026-05-18).

Dose-response is supralinear at high exposures + uncertain at lower (<100 µg/L) exposures with continued risk demonstrated by cohort studies. Sustained acid suppression → hypergastrinemia → enterochromaffin-like (ECL) cell hyperplasia in gastric body / fundus mucosa → small but measurable elevation in well-differentiated Type-1 gastric neuroendocrine tumors (gastric NET, formerly gastric carcinoid). Avoid bevacizumab in elderly with HTN / vascular disease.

ClarIDHy phase 3 (Abou-Alfa et al. Lance: ClarIDHy phase 3 (Abou-Alfa et al. Lancet Oncol 2020): ivosidenib 500 mg PO daily continuous vs placebo in advanced/metastatic IDH1-mutant cholangiocarcinoma post ≥1L systemic therapy (typically gemcitabine/cisplatin ± durvalumab in modern practice). N=185 randomized 2:1 (ivo n=124, pbo n=61). mPFS 2.7 vs 1.4 mo, HR 0.37 (95% CI 0.25–0.54), p<0.0001. Disease control rate 53% vs 28%. Classical P-loop mutation of ABL1. Reduc: Classical P-loop mutation of ABL1. Reduces nilotinib sensitivity (IC50 ~5-7x baseline) and imatinib sensitivity (IC50 ~10-20x); associated with adverse prognosis on imatinib. Dasatinib, bosutinib, ponatinib retain in-vitro activity. Per ELN-2020 / ELN-2025: detection on nilotinib or imatinib failure → switch to dasatinib (preferred 2G-TKI option) or ponatinib. P-loop mutations as a class (E255K, Y253H, G250E) generally favor dasatinib-based salvage; T315I excluded per separate biomarker.
Classical gatekeeper mutation analogous: Classical gatekeeper mutation analogous to EGFR T790M and ALK L1196M. T315 normally forms a hydrogen bond with imatinib; the T→I substitution introduces a bulky isoleucine side chain that sterically blocks all type-II ATP-competitive TKIs (imatinib, nilotinib, dasatinib, bosutinib). Ponatinib (PACE, Cortes 2013) was specifically designed to accommodate the I315 side chain via a triple-bond linker and remains active. Asciminib (ASCEMBL, Rea 2021) — an allosteric STAMP inhibitor binding the myristoyl pocket — also retains activity at higher doses (200 mg BID for T315I). Per ELN-2020 and ELN-2025, T315I screening is mandatory at TKI failure or suboptimal response; presence dictates ponatinib or asciminib choice over 2G-TKI. In Ph+ B-ALL, T315I emerges rapidly under non-ponatinib TKI pressure — ponatinib + chemo (or + blinatumomab) is preferred when detected.

Colloidal bismuth salt that, in the acid: Colloidal bismuth salt that, in the acid gastric milieu, precipitates as bismuth oxychloride and bismuth citrate, which: (i) adhere to ulcer craters and the gastric mucus layer to form a protective barrier; (ii) directly damage Helicobacter pylori cell wall and impair iron and nickel uptake — bactericidal effect; (iii) inhibit H. pylori urease, phospholipase, and proteolytic enzymes; (iv) stimulate prostaglandin E2, bicarbonate, and mucus secretion. Synergistic with metronidazole and tetracycline in quadruple therapy — also overcomes clarithromycin resistance, the primary mode of failure for standard triple therapy.

Companion to BIO-EBV-STATUS (qualitative: Companion to BIO-EBV-STATUS (qualitative tissue EBER-ISH). EBV-DNA is the *quantitative* serum marker used for: - **Extranodal NK/T nasal-type lymphoma**: pre-treatment baseline; monitoring during SMILE / DDGP / asparaginase-based regimens; post-treatment surveillance. Rising EBV-DNA on therapy correlates with poor response; persistent post-treatment positivity predicts relapse. - **PTLD**: EBV-driven PTLD shows EBV-DNA load decrease with rituximab + reduced immunosuppression; trend is response surrogate. - **HIV-associated EBV+ DLBCL / plasmablastic / primary effusion**: contextual; not standardly used for treatment decisions. - **Post-HSCT monitoring**: weekly EBV-DNA used to detect early PTLD risk; preemptive rituximab if doubling. Competitive antagonist at opioid recepto: Competitive antagonist at opioid receptors. In alcohol use disorder (AUD), blocks endogenous opioid-mediated reward signaling triggered by alcohol ingestion → reduces craving and heavy-drinking days. First-line FDA-approved AUD pharmacotherapy (alongside acamprosate and disulfiram). Also FDA-approved for opioid use disorder (block opioid effect — requires opioid-free interval first).
Competitive inhibitor of 5-alpha-reducta: Inhibidor competitivo de la isoenzima de 5-alfa-reductasa tipo 2; bloquea la conversión de testosterona a dihidrotestosterona (DHT) en la próstata, los folículos capilares y la piel. Reduce el DHT intraprostático en ~85-90% mientras que la testosteronina sérica aumenta ~10-15%. Ensayo de Prevención del Cáncer de Próstata (PCPT, NCT00000484, Thompson NEJM 2003 + 2013 a largo plazo): reducción relativa del 25% en la incidencia del cáncer de próstata a los 7 años, pero señal de aumento de la detección de Gleason ≥7 (reanudada y parcialmente atribuida a sesgo de detección; mortalidad a largo tiempo no aumentó).
Competitive inhibitor of both type 1 and: Competitive inhibitor of both type 1 and type 2 isoforms of 5-alpha- reductase, contrasting with finasteride (type 2 selective). Reduces intraprostatic and serum dihydrotestosterone (DHT) by ~90-95% — a more complete androgen blockade than finasteride. Prostate cancer prevention rationale identical to finasteride: lowering DHT reduces androgen-driven epithelial proliferation. REDUCE trial (Andriole NEJM 2010, NCT00056407): 23% relative reduction in prostate cancer incidence at 4 years in men with prior negative biopsy and elevated PSA, with a high-grade Gleason 8-10 signal similar to PCPT but modest (small absolute number).
Competitive reversible H1 receptor antag: Competitive reversible H1 receptor antagonist that blocks histamine- mediated vasodilation, increased capillary permeability, smooth- muscle contraction, sensory nerve stimulation, and pruritus. Lipophilic — readily crosses the blood-brain barrier producing significant sedation. Additional actions: muscarinic antagonism (anticholinergic — dry mouth, urinary retention, mydriasis, constipation, confusion in elderly), modest α1-adrenergic antagonism (mild orthostatic hypotension), and 5-HT-antagonist / D2-antagonist effects contributing to antiemetic and antimotion- sickness activity. In oncology supportive care, used as: (1) premedication for chemotherapy infusion reactions (paclitaxel, carboplatin retreatment, rituximab, monoclonal antibodies); (2) adjunct treatment of mild-to-moderate hypersensitivity / infusion reactions (mainstay of pruritus, urticaria, mild bronchospasm — but NOT a s...
Competitively inhibits 3-hydroxy-3-methy: Inhibe competitivamente la 3-hidroxi-3-metilglutaril coenzima A (HMG-CoA) reductasa, bloqueando el paso limitante de la biosíntesis de mevalonato / colesterol y la reactivación de los receptores de LDL hepáticos. Razonamiento de prevención del cáncer: efectos pleiotrópicos (disminución de la prenilación isoprenoide de Ras/Rho, antiinflamatorio, antiproliferativo, pro-apoptótico) y desregulación de las señales tumorales de la vía mevalonata. Las metaanálisis observacionales sugieren una reducción modesta de la incidencia de CRC, hepatocelular, esofágica y de cáncer de próstata; la evidencia de nivel RCT sigue ausente.

Composite codon-phenotype classification: Composite codon-phenotype classification for MEN2 (germline RET- activating pathogenic variants). ATA 2015 / NCCN 2025 stratify carriers into three syndromic subtypes and four codon-based risk tiers driving prophylactic-thyroidectomy timing. Syndromic subtypes: • MEN2A (~75% of MEN2): MTC + pheochromocytoma (~50%) + primary hyperparathyroidism (~25%); occasional cutaneous lichen amyloidosis or Hirschsprung disease. Codons mostly cysteine-rich extracellular domain (609, 611, 618, 620, 630, 634). • MEN2B (~5%): MTC (earliest onset, most aggressive) + pheo (~50%) + marfanoid habitus + mucosal neuromas (tongue, lips, GI) + medullated corneal nerves. Codon M918T (95%) or A883F (rare). • FMTC (~20%): MTC only, no pheo / no HPT. Codons 768, 790, 791, 804, 891 (lower-risk codons) — increasingly considered MEN2A variant with low-penetrance pheo. ATA RET risk tiers driving prophylactic-thyroidectomy timing: • Highest risk (ATA HST): M918T → thyroidectomy by age 1 (before metastatic MTC). • High risk (ATA H): C634, A883F → by age 5. • Moderate risk (ATA MOD): 609, 611, 618, 620, 630, 768, 790, 791, 804, 891 → individualized; consider 5-10 years (basal calcitonin + neck US trigger). Composite gate harmonized across landmar: Composite gate harmonized across landmark ASCT trials. AML uses age <65 cutoff (more restrictive than lymphoma/MM <70) due to higher TRM in older AML alloHCT/ASCT pathways; chronological age is a proxy — biologic-age assessment (CGA, HCT-CI score) overrides for borderline cases. DLCO threshold 50% is a hard limit for many centers; 40-50% with cardiopulmonary fitness clearance acceptable on individual basis. Frailty score (Palumbo IMWG-frailty for MM, G8 for solid/lymphoma) preferred over isolated age cutoff. RF coexists with RF-CAR-T-ELIGIBLE for cases where both are options (DLBCL 2L: ZUMA-7/TRANSFORM established CAR-T over ASCT in early relapse <12 mo or primary refractory; ASCT remains standard for late-relapse R/R DLBCL post-CR). MM tandem-ASCT (StaMINA) for high-risk cytogenetics — additional gate when this RF fires AND RF-MM-HIGH-RISK-CYTOGENETICS fires.

La enfermedad activa del SNC requiere control (resección / IT / RT) antes de la linfodepleción; algunos centros ofrecen CAR-T para el linfoma primario del SCN con criterios restringidos. El plan de unión es crítico — la fabricación toma 2-5 semanas; si la quimioterapia puente da PR/CR, linfodopleción todavía está programada. Inelegibilidad para un producto (por ejemplo, riesgo de parkinsonismo de cilta-cel) no excluye otro (ide-cel).

Composite genotype-phenotype classificat: Composite genotype-phenotype classification for von Hippel-Lindau syndrome (germline VHL pathogenic variant carriers). Four canonical subtypes based on pheochromocytoma risk and variant class: • Type 1: complete-loss-of-function variants (truncating, large deletions, missense disrupting elongin-binding) — RCC + CNS/retinal hemangioblastomas + pancreatic NET/cysts WITHOUT pheochromocytoma (or very low pheo risk). • Type 2A: specific missense variants (e.g., Tyr98His) — pheo + CNS/ retinal hemangioblastomas, LOW RCC risk. • Type 2B: missense variants (e.g., Arg167Trp / Arg167Gln) — pheo + RCC + CNS/retinal hemangioblastomas (full classical VHL spectrum). • Type 2C: rare missense variants (e.g., Leu188Val) — pheochromocytoma ONLY (no RCC, no hemangioblastomas). Confirmed germline pathogenic / likely-pathogenic variant in FLCN (folliculin) — Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome (BHD). Autosomal-dominant. Classic clinical triad: fibrofolliculomas (skin papules of face/neck/ upper trunk, often dermatologic presenting feature), pulmonary cysts + spontaneous pneumothorax (cumulative lifetime pneumothorax ~30-40%; imaging shows multiple basal/subpleural cysts), and renal cell carcinoma (~16-32% lifetime risk; characteristic chromophobe + hybrid oncocytic + clear-cell histologies; bilateral + multifocal common; often presents younger — 40s-50s — than sporadic RCC). FLCN encodes folliculin, an mTOR pathway regulator; loss-of-function variants cause BHD. Patient has confirmed positive germline test; no current personal cancer diagnosis in the carrier being assessed. Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20, v0.3 rare-hereditary expansion Wave P2).

Cronkhite-Canada syndrome — acquired non-Mendelian polyposis- ectodermal syndrome. Rare (~1000 reported cases globally; primarily middle-aged + elderly adults). Clinical presentation: gastrointestinal polyposis (juvenile-like, throughout stomach + small bowel + colon diffusely) + ectodermal changes (diffuse alopecia, nail dystrophy with onycholysis, skin hyperpigmentation) + protein-losing enteropathy (hypoalbuminemia, edema, weight loss, electrolyte derangement). Lifetime CRC risk ~12-25%; gastric cancer also elevated per IPCG case-series. Pathogenesis unclear — autoimmune-like; may respond to immunosuppression (prednisone, azathioprine) + nutritional support; untreated mortality high (~50% 5-year if uncontrolled). ICI-class management protocols apply uniformly: baseline TFTs, cortisol, glucose, LFTs, renal panel, troponin if combo with CTLA-4 ICI; serial labs every cycle. DDR2 (Discoidin Domain Receptor Tyrosine: DDR2 (Discoidin Domain Receptor Tyrosine Kinase 2) is a collagen receptor RTK that signals through SRC, MAPK, and PI3K cascades. Activating mutations occur in ~2–4% of squamous cell NSCLC (enriched in squamous histology; rare in adenocarcinoma). Dasatinib inhibits DDR2 kinase in vitro and preclinical models, but clinical responses have been anecdotal (case reports/small series only). No Phase III trial or FDA approval for DDR2-selected therapy. DDR2 mutation in squamous NSCLC co-occurs with FGFR1 amplification (~10–15% of SqCC) and does not exclude standard-of-care chemoimmunotherapy. Clinical significance: investigational target; not used to select therapy outside clinical trials.

DDR2 activating mutations are identified: DDR2 activating mutations are identified in ~2–4% of squamous cell carcinoma of the lung (enriched in squamous vs. adenocarcinoma). DDR2 signals via SRC and MAPK pathways; dasatinib (a BCR-ABL/SRC/KIT inhibitor) also inhibits DDR2 kinase. Clinical evidence: (1) Preclinical: DDR2 S768R-mutant lines sensitive to dasatinib in vitro; erlotinib not active. (2) Clinical (LUNG-MAP S1400D, NCT02154490): phase II umbrella trial with dasatinib for DDR2-mutant squamous NSCLC was closed early due to insufficient enrollment and limited signals; no significant ORR reported. (3) Case reports: isolated responses to dasatinib in DDR2-mutant squamous NSCLC (Hammerman et al. Cancer Discov 2011); no prospective validation. Standard of care for squamous NSCLC (regardless of DDR2 status): pembrolizumab ± carboplatin/ nab-paclitaxel/paclitaxel (KEYNOTE-789/407) per PD-L1 and histology. DDR2 mutation does not modify treatment algorithm in current guidelines. ESCAT IIIB: prognostic/investigational marker with insufficient clinical evidence to guide therapy selection.

DICER1 germline pathogenic variants cause DICER1 tumor predisposition syndrome — broad spectrum centered on pleuropulmonary blastoma (PPB) in early childhood, ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor in adolescence / young-adult females, multinodular goiter + differentiated thyroid cancer, cystic nephroma, embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (cervix / bladder / kidney), pineoblastoma, and pituitary blastoma. Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol (per International PPB Registry Consensus / Stewart et al. 2019 / DICER1 Cancer Predisposition Surveillance Statement): chest CT (low-dose) at age 3-6 months + 2.5 years + 8 years (PPB peak incidence < 6 years), chest X-ray q6mo to age 8 then annually to age 12, abdominal/pelvic US q6-12mo from infancy through age 8 then annual through adolescence, thyroid US q3y starting age 8, gynecologic exam + transabdominal pelvic US annual from age 8-10 (Sertoli-Leydig). Symptom-directed brain MRI for pineoblastoma / pituitary blastoma concern. Smoking avoidance is critical (synergistic lung-tumor risk). ESCAT IIA.

Defining indication for tumor-agnostic N: Defining indication for tumor-agnostic NTRK-targeted therapy in pediatric oncology — historical care was VAC chemotherapy (vincristine + actinomycin + cyclophosphamide) ± surgery, with morbidity from large surgical resections in young infants. Therapy: - Larotrectinib (SCOUT pediatric arm): ORR ~94% in NTRK-fusion+ IFS; used as neoadjuvant to convert unresectable / morbid resections to function-preserving surgery. - Entrectinib (STARTRK-NG): similar approach. - Surgery: complete resection if achievable without major morbidity; otherwise neoadjuvant TRK inhibitor → re-evaluate resection. - Chemotherapy (VAC): reserved for fusion-negative or TRK-resistant cases. Resistance: solvent-front (G623R for NTRK3; G595R for NTRK1) and gatekeeper mutations on progression — selitrectinib / repotrectinib in development. Pediatric cardiac / neurodevelopmental long-term monitoring on TRK inhibitors is an active research question.
Defining stratification within systemic: Defining stratification within systemic ALCL: - **ALCL ALK+** (~70% of systemic ALCL): younger patients (median ~30-40), favorable prognosis (~70-80% 5y OS), responds well to CHP-Bv. Brentuximab + crizotinib emerging in r/r. - **ALCL ALK-** (~30%): older (median ~60), adverse prognosis (~30-40% 5y OS), benefits more from autoSCT consolidation in CR1. Both ALK+ and ALK- treated with same 1L (CHP-Bv per ECHELON-2). Status drives **consolidation strategy** (autoSCT for fit younger ALK- in CR1) and **r/r therapy choice** (crizotinib for ALK+ vs brentuximab/clinical trial for ALK-). Outside ALCL: ALK rearrangements in NSCLC drive crizotinib/alectinib (different therapeutic context); inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor (IMT). Lymphoma scope: ALCL only.

Clinical use: in mCRPC patient who has progressed on first-line ARSI and is being considered for second-line ARSI (abiraterone-after-enzalutamide or vice-versa), AR-V7-positive status is a strong argument for switching to taxane chemotherapy or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 (if PSMA-positive on PSMA-PET) instead. Diagnostic criterion for ET (~25%) and P: Diagnostic criterion for ET (~25%) and PMF (~25–30%); essentially absent in PV. Mutually exclusive with JAK2 V617F and MPL W515 (the three drive ~95% of MPNs). Type 1 (52-bp del) carries more myelofibrotic phenotype and better OS in PMF; type 2 (5-bp ins) more thrombocytosis-predominant ET phenotype with lower thrombosis risk. JAK inhibitors (ruxolitinib, momelotinib, fedratinib, pacritinib) are not mutation-specific — they target downstream JAK-STAT, so they work in CALR-, JAK2-, and MPL-driven disease. Mutant CALR is also a tumor-specific neoantigen — anti-mutCALR immunotherapy in early-phase trials.
Diagnostic for PV (V617F or exon 12 — to: Diagnostic for PV (V617F or exon 12 — together ≥98%), ET (~50–60% V617F), PMF (~50–60% V617F). Mutually exclusive with CALR and MPL. JAK2 inhibitors (ruxolitinib COMFORT-I/II; fedratinib JAKARTA-2; pacritinib PERSIST-2; momelotinib MOMENTUM) treat MF symptoms + splenomegaly across all driver genotypes. Ruxolitinib is also 1L for hydroxyurea-resistant / -intolerant PV (RESPONSE) and approved for symptomatic / high-risk ET in some jurisdictions. Allele burden reduction on therapy correlates with longer-term outcomes in PV / MF but is not a treatment switch trigger.

Diaminocyclohexane (DACH) platinum compo: Diaminocyclohexane (DACH) platinum compound. Forms intra- and inter- strand platinum-DNA adducts (preferentially N7 of guanine), bulkier than cisplatin/carboplatin adducts and recognized differently by the mismatch-repair machinery — explains partial activity in MMR-deficient tumors. Cumulative dose-dependent peripheral sensory neuropathy is the signature toxicity (acute cold-induced + chronic stocking-glove). Backbone of FOLFOX, CAPOX, FOLFIRINOX, FLOT.

Differentiated thyroid carcinoma — most: Differentiated thyroid carcinoma — most indolent of common cancers. Standard care: surgery → risk-stratified RAI ablation → TSH suppression → calibrated thyroglobulin (Tg) monitoring. Radioiodine-refractory progressive disease is the trigger for systemic therapy: - Multikinase TKI 1L: lenvatinib (SELECT) or sorafenib (DECISION). - Targeted by genotype: * BRAF V600E (~50% PTC): dabrafenib + trametinib (MARCH/REINK compassionate-use; FDA tumor-agnostic 2022 BRAF V600E approval for solid tumors); single-agent dabrafenib also active. * RET fusion: selpercatinib (LIBRETTO-531; positive 2024) and pralsetinib (ARROW) — selpercatinib FDA-approved for RET-fusion+ thyroid cancer. * NTRK fusion: larotrectinib / entrectinib (tumor-agnostic). * Re-differentiation strategies: short-course MAPK inhibitor (selumetinib / dabrafenib + trametinib) restoring RAI uptake — under study. Aggressive variants (tall cell, hobnail, columnar, diffuse sclerosing) upstage to higher recurrence-risk groups even when small.

Distinct from BIO-CD79B-IHC (which captu: Distinto de BIO-CD79B-IHC (que capta la expresión de proteínas como objetivo de polituzumab-vedotina). Este biomarcador captura activa *mutaciones* en el dominio ITAM (más comúnmente Y196F/H/N/S/I) que impulsan la señalización de BCR activa crónica. Relevancia de enfermedades cruzadas: - **DLBCL (MCD / C5 cluster)** (~20% de ABC-DLBCL): co-mutados con MYD88 L265P → define el subtipo Linfogen MCD. Sensible a BTKi (ibrutinib en monoterapia ORR ~80% en DLBCL de MCD R/R; justificación para R-CHOP + ibrutiniB en ajuste MCD 1L por subgrupo PHOENIX). - **PCNSL** (~30-50%): también co-clusters con MYD88 L265P; ibruinib cruza BBB y muestra actividad R/ R (Grommes 2017). -**CLL** ( ~3%): rara; no controlador actual de la decisión de tratamiento. Actualmente un componente LinfGen MCD clasificador en DlBCL/PCNLS; motor utiliza la presencia como entrada para la selección de regímenes orientados a la BCR-pathway. `multi_allele_mvp` omite la razón: ITAM-Y196 tiene múltiples alelos recurrentes sin un único hotspot canónico — posponer la búsqueda de accionabilidad por variable a post-MVP.
Distinct from BIO-FGFR2 (gene-level alte: Distinto de BIO-FGFR2 (alteraciones de nivel de génesis: fusión / amplificación / mutación). FGFR 2b-IHC es el biomarcador de acompañamiento de nivel proteico para bemarituzumab — anti-FFG FR2b chimérico IgG1 mAb con aumento de Fc afucosilado ADCC. La fase 2 (Wainberg, Lancet Oncol 2022) usa FG FR 2b 2+/3+ en ≥10% de las células tumorales como umbral de elegibilidad; la fase 3 FORTITUDE-101 (cito como-es — fuente tallo pendiente de actualización de cita) utiliza el mismo umbral. El desarrollo de la DIV de diagnóstico-compañero en curso junto con la lectura de FORTITUDE-101. Nota: FGFR2-pan IHC y FG FR2b-IHC NO son intercambiables; sólo el anticuerpo selectivo de isoforma IIIb permite la selección de pacientes con bemarituzumab.

Distinct from other head/neck SCCs: EBV-: Distinct from other head/neck SCCs: EBV-associated, lymphoepithelial histology, very chemo- and radio-sensitive, distinct anatomic challenges (skull-base proximity, retropharyngeal nodal drainage). Treatment: definitive concurrent chemoradiation for locally advanced disease (cisplatin + IMRT); induction chemo (gemcitabine + cisplatin) showing OS benefit in recent trials. Metastatic 1L: gemcitabine + cisplatin + toripalimab or camrelizumab (PD-1) per recent Chinese Phase 3s. Plasma EBV-DNA used for post-treatment surveillance — rising levels predict relapse months before imaging.

Hereditary testing recommended for ALL PGL diagnoses regardless of age or family history.

Acceso UA: pirtubrutiniB aún no está listado NSZU; vías internacionales de acceso temprano.

PLCG2 mutations (R665W, S707F/Y, L845F) are an alternative resistance mechanism (~15%) — also responds to pirtobrutinib. Test at PD by ddPCR or NGS on peripheral-blood mononuclear cells. Brexucabtagene autoleucel (CAR-T, ZUMA-2) is the alternative for CAR-T-eligible post-cBTKi MCL; pirtobrutinib preferred for CAR-T-ineligible (age, comorbidity, organ dysfunction). Access UA: pirtobrutinib not yet NSZU-listed; international early-access pathways.

Diterpenoid originally isolated from Pac: Diterpenoide originalmente aislado del yew del Pacífico (Taxus brevifolia). Ata la subunidad β de tubulina polimerizada en el sitio de unión de los taxones, promoviendo el ensamblaje de microtubulos y estabilizando los microtubulos existentes contra la despolimerización. Las células detienen en la fase G2/M de transición incapaz de completar mitosis, desencadenando apoptosis. Solubilizado en Cremophor-EL (aceite de ricino polioxietilado) + alcohol deshidratado — Cremofor-EL es responsable de las reacciones de hipersensibilidad características y requiere premedicación con corticosteroides + H1 + H2 antihistamínicos.

Do NOT use in tumor-only-BRCA without ge: NO usar en el BRCA-sólo tumor sin confirmación de la línea germinal (inclusión de la POLO fue línea germinativa)
Do NOT use mobocertinib — FDA approval w: NO use mobocertinib: la aprobación de la FDA se retiró en 2023 (ensayo de confirmación negativa).
Do NOT use olaparib maintenance in HRD-n: NO use el mantenimiento de olaparib en HRD negativa — beneficio mínimo, riesgo de MDS/AML
Do NOT use outside clinical trial or ter: NO use fuera del ensayo clínico o del centro terciario, régimen experimental.
Do NOT use pembrolizumab monotherapy as: NO use pembrolizumab en monoterapia como 1L en enfermedad de crisis visceral/de progresión rápida, riesgo de progresión temprana antes de que se establezca la cinética de IO.
Do NOT use pembrolizumab monotherapy in: NO use pembrolizumab en monoterapia en CPS <20; se prefiere la quimioterapia-IO o EXTREME.
Do NOT use platinum reinduction here — P: No utilice la reinducción de platino aquí — PFI ≤ 6 mo define la resistencia al platino
Do NOT use radioactive iodine (RAI) in M: NO use yodo radiactivo (IRA) en MTC: las células C parafoliculares no concentran yoduro; el IRA tiene una eficacia cero.
Do NOT use rechallenge immediately after: NO use rehallenge inmediatamente después de la anterior anti-EGFR (sin línea intermedia) — la selección clonal aún no ha decaído.
Do NOT use sotorasib in combination with: NO use sotorasib en combinación con PPI, lo que reduce significativamente la absorción (disolución dependiente del ácido).
Do NOT use systemic PD-1 immunotherapy i: Do NOT use systemic PD-1 immunotherapy instead of definitive CCRT in non-metastatic (M0) disease — that is the metastatic-1L indication (IND-NPC-1L-METASTATIC-GC-PD1), not locally advanced disease.
Do NOT use this regimen if PFI ≤6 months: NO use este régimen si PFI ≤ 6 meses (resistente al platino - cambiar a la columna vertebral de AURELIA)
Do NOT use this regimen if cumulative an: NO use este régimen si la antraciclina acumulada se aproxima a 550 mg/m2 por vida
Do NOT use together with proton-pump inh: NO utilizar junto con inhibidores de la bomba de protones o bloqueadores de H2 — absorción suprimida (administrar con cola para la acidificación si se requiere IPP).
Do NOT use toripalimab/camrelizumab mono: NO use toripalimab/camrelizumab en monoterapia como 1L sin una columna vertebral de quimioterapia fuera del entorno paliativo inelegible para el platino — tanto JUPITER-02 como CAPTAIN-1 estudió la combinación PD-1 + GP, no en mongolia, en 1L.
Do NOT use with confirmed history of sev: NO utilizar con antecedentes confirmados de VOD/SOS graves, IC absoluto.
Do NOT use with uncontrolled hypertensio: Do NOT use with uncontrolled hypertension — manage BP to <140/90 before starting
Do NOT use without G-CSF prophylaxis — n: NO utilizar sin profilaxis G-CSF — tasa de neutropenia ~50%
Do NOT use without HER2 testing — HER2+: Do NOT use without HER2 testing — HER2+ patients get trastuzumab+chemo instead
Do NOT use without addressing biliary ob: NO utilizar sin abordar la obstrucción biliar primero
Do NOT use without baseline LVEF — trast: NO utilizar sin FEVI basal — trastuzumab cardiotóxico (monitorización del eco de 3-mo)
Do NOT use without confirmation of ritux: NO utilizar sin confirmar la refractación de rituximab: el beneficio de obinutuzumab está establecido específicamente en el ajuste refractario de ritusimab (GADOLIN).

Do not accept the access barrier as immu: No acepte la barrera de acceso como inmutable — coordina proactivamente NSZU / Medicare / NHS vías de referencia.
Do not add GO in adverse-risk AML (TP53-: Do not add GO in adverse-risk AML (TP53-mutant, complex karyotype, monosomy 7) — no benefit + toxicity persists.
Do not add GO without CD33 validation —: No agregue GO sin validación CD33 — CD33-flow ≥20% blast requerido; CD33 - bajo/negativo AML — sin señal de beneficio.
Do not add chemoimmunotherapy before eva: No agregue quimioinmunioterapia antes de evaluar la respuesta al DAA en el mes 6 (la escalada prematura niega la esencia de la lógica antiviral-primero).
Do not administer Gardasil-9 during acut: No administre Gardasil-9 durante una enfermedad grave aguda, posponer.
Do not administer Gardasil-9 during preg: No administre Gardasil-9 durante el embarazo, posponer al postparto (aunque la vacunación inadvertida no muestra teratogenicidad).
Do not administer PPI on UBT day — false: No administre IPP el día UBT, resultado falso negativo.
Do not administer bendamustine at CrCl <: Do not administer bendamustine at CrCl <30 mL/min without dose adjustment — toxicity increases exponentially.
Do not administer nivolumab for active a: No administrar nivolumab para enfermedad autoinmune activa que requiera inmunodepresión sistémica >10 mg/d equivalente a prednisona
Do not administer therapy without prior: No administrar el tratamiento sin bloqueo tiroideo previo (iodeto de potasio/iodato).
Do not administer vincristine (if escala: Do not administer vincristine (if escalation to R-CHOP) intrathecally — fatal.
Do not administer vincristine (if in any: Do not administer vincristine (if in any supplementary regimen) intrathecally — fatal.
Do not administer vincristine (if in sub: Do not administer vincristine (if in subsequent regimen) intrathecally — fatal.
Do not administer vincristine (if in subsequent regimen) intrathecally.
Do not administer vincristine intratheca: Do not administer vincristine intrathecally — FATAL.

Do not allow supply gaps — abrupt cessat: No permitir lagunas de suministro: la cesación abrupta corre el riesgo de una rápida recaída; garantizar la continuidad internacional de la oferta.
Do not assess lymphoma response earlier: No evalúe la respuesta al linfoma antes de 6 meses después de la RVS12: la remisión se desarrolla lentamente.

Do not auto-prescribe aspirin from confi: No auto-prescribir la aspirina desde el estado confirmado del portador — toma de decisiones compartida con riesgo de hemorragia, GI / función renal, y evaluación de la terapia concomitante; datos CAPP2 más fuertes en portadores MLH1 / MSH2 que MSH6 / PMS2.
Do not auto-prescribe aspirin without bl: No prescribir automáticamente aspirina sin riesgo de hemorragia, GI/función renal y evaluación concomitante de antiagregantes plaquetarios/ anticoagulantes.
Do not avoid re-engagement opportunity —: No evite la oportunidad de reinserción: cada recaída es datos; un paciente puede participar en el sexto intento después de la sexta recaída.
No evite la oportunidad de reinserción, la mayoría de los pacientes eventualmente se involucran cuando desencadena un cambio motivacional.
Do not avoid weight-related obesity-clus: No evite las discusiones sobre el cáncer de obesidad relacionada con el peso debido a preocupaciones sobre el estigma del peso — la realidad clínica requiere un encuadramiento honesto con compasión.
Do not block pedigree review on the basi: No bloquee la revisión de la genealogía sobre la base del seguro / pagador - el asesoramiento pre-test a menudo está cubierto o de bajo costo; panel-prueba de la barrera de costos puede ser abordado a través de la vía de cascada para los familiares índice-caso.
Do not cease cervical screening at age 6: No deje de realizar el cribado cervical a los 65 años en la cohorte inmunocomprometida; persiste la elevación del riesgo.
Do not change a transplant recipient's i: No cambie unilateralmente el régimen de inmunosupresión de un receptor de trasplante, sin consultar con el equipo de trasplantes.
No cambie la inmunosupresión de un receptor de trasplante sin consultar con el equipo de trasplantes, incluso durante la quimioterapia.
Do not close the door on re-engagement —: No cierre la puerta cuando vuelva a comprometerse, la mayoría de los pacientes eventualmente se involucran cuando surgen síntomas.

Do not combine BTKi with warfarin withou: No combine BTKi con warfarina sin un estricto control, riesgo de hemorragia.
Do not combine asparaginase with warfari: No combine asparaginasa con warfarina sin monitorización INR — coagulopatía.
Do not combine brentuximab with bleomyci: Do not combine brentuximab with bleomycin — lethal pulmonary toxicity.
Do not combine sofosbuvir with amiodaron: No combine sofosbuvir con amiodarona, riesgo de bradicardia grave y paro cardíaco.
No combine sofosbuvir con amiodarona, riesgo de bradicardia grave.
Do not combine with NSAIDs / PPIs / peni: No combinar con AINEs/ISP/penicilinas durante la fase HD-MTX — reducción del aclaramiento.

No se combine con medicamentos que prolonguen el intervalo QT sin una estricta vigilancia.
Do not combine with anticoagulants witho: No se combine con anticoagulantes sin una estricta vigilancia: persiste el riesgo de hemorragia.

Do not combine with bleomycin — lethal p: Do not combine with bleomycin — lethal pulmonary toxicity (absolute).
Do not combine with brentuximab without: No combinar con brentuximab sin entrada de MDT — toxicidad combinada (citopenia + infección) sustancial.
Do not combine with gemfibrozil — marked: Do not combine with gemfibrozil — markedly increases bexarotene levels.
Do not combine with immunosuppressants /: No combinar con inmunosupresores/vacunas vivas durante el tratamiento.
Do not combine with immunosuppression or: No se combine con inmunosupresión ni vacunas vivas.
Do not combine with ipilimumab/ICI outsi: No combinar con ipilimumab/ICI fuera de los ensayos, se desconoce la seguridad de combinación.
Do not combine with other FGFR-selective: No se combine con otros inhibidores selectivos del FGFR o con el tratamiento dirigido por CLDN18.2 fuera de los ensayos.
Do not combine with other immunosuppress: No combinar con otros inmunosupresores sin dermatología + coordinación ID – riesgo de infección elevado.
Do not combine with other myelosuppressi: No se combine con otros agentes mielosupresores sin ajuste.
Do not combine with other myelotoxic dru: No se combine con otros medicamentos mielotóxicos sin una justificación clara.
Do not combine with peg-IFN without a cl: No se combine con peg-IFN sin un protocolo claro.
Do not combine with peg-IFN-α without a: No se combine con peg-IFN-α sin un protocolo claro: dosificación de ambos cambios.
Do not combine with strong CYP3A4 inhibi: No combinar con inhibidores fuertes del CYP3A4 sin reducción de dosis (50%).
Do not combine with vitamin A supplement: No se combine con suplementos de vitamina A, toxicidad aditiva.
No se combine con suplementos de vitamina A.
Do not combine with warfarin without INR: No combinar con warfarina sin monitorización INR, mayor riesgo de hemorragia.
Do not combine with warfarin without mod: No combinar con warfarina sin una supervisión modificada del INR — Inr aumenta sustancialmente.
Do not combine with warfarin without str: No combinar con warfarina sin un estricto control, riesgo de hemorragia (aunque inferior a ibrutinib).
No se combine con warfarin sin un estricto control.
Do not confirm D-Rd plan without verifie: No confirme el plan D-Rd sin la vía de financiación verificada — daratumumab NO se reembolsa a través de NSZU; el paciente debe ser informado antes de que se anuncie el plan.
Do not confirm D-VRd plan without verifi: No confirme el plan D-VRd sin la vía de financiación verificada — daratumumab NO se reembolsa a través de NSZU; el paciente debe ser informado antes de que se anuncie el plan.
Do not confirm plan without funding path: No confirme el plan sin la vía de financiación (~USD 500-700K todo-en) + viaje/loja + ausencia de 6 semanas de casa.

Do not confirm plan without internationa: No confirme el plan sin la vía de remisión internacional + financiación — droga no disponible en Ucrania.
Do not confirm plan without verified fun: No confirmar el plan sin la vía de financiación verificada — Enco+BINI fuera de la bolsa en Ucrania.

No confirme el plan sin la vía de financiación verificada — relatlimab no registrado en Ucrania; vía = importación de pacientes designados.
Do not confirm the plan without funding: No confirme el plan sin la vía de financiación — bemarituzumab no registrado; acceso a través de un paciente designado / clínica-ensayo solamente.
No confirme el plan sin la vía de financiación — zolbetuximab no registrado en la UA.
Do not confirm the plan without verified: No confirme el plan sin la vía de financiación verificada — NSZU 2026 NO cubre T-DXd para el estómago.
No confirme el plan sin la vía de financiación verificada — NSZU 2026 NO cubre el nivolumab para el esófago.

Do not consider e-cigarettes / vaping a: No considere los cigarrillos electrónicos / vaping una herramienta de cese — IARC recomienda en contra; las herramientas de cesación arriba han establecido perfil de seguridad.
Do not consider observation equivalent t: Do not consider observation equivalent to antiviral suppression — incidence-reduction is absent.
Do not continue >12 weeks without object: No continúe > 12 semanas sin respuesta objetiva (PR/CR) — cambio temprano a ICI o BRAFi+MEKi si BRAF-co-mutado.
Do not continue ESA in the absence of re: Do not continue ESA in the absence of response at 8-12 weeks — switch to luspatercept (if available) / lenalidomide / HMA.
Do not continue HRT by default without p: No continúe la THS por defecto sin una reevaluación periódica del riesgo-beneficio: el riesgo CV evoluciona con la edad.
Do not continue HRT by default without s: No continúe la THS por defecto sin revisión de la decisión compartida en el año 5 y anualmente.
Do not continue PPI indefinitely after a: No continúe con el IPP indefinidamente después de un evento agudo (úlcera de estrés, post-AINE) — reevaluar en cada seguimiento.
Do not continue PPI without active indic: No continúe con el IPP sin revisión de la indicación activa — la desprescripción es la intervención de mayor rendimiento, no la vigilancia.
Do not continue after the first progress: No continúe después de la primera progresión — la eficacia de un agente es limitada; considere la remisión clínico-intra-instrumental.
Do not continue at Grade ≥3 irAE without: No continúe con el IRAE de Grado ≥3 sin considerar la suspensión permanente.
Do not continue at grade 3 effusions / e: No continúe con los derrames/ edema de grado 3 – sostén + diurético; considere la interrupción permanente.
Do not continue at suspicion of pneumoni: No continúe con la sospecha de neumonitis: retención inmediata + pulmonólogo + corticoesteroides.
Do not continue ipi+nivo with Grade ≥3 i: No continúe con ipi+nivo con iraE de grado ≥3: cambie a mantenimiento nivo o pare.
Do not continue maintenance at Grade ≥2: No continúe el mantenimiento con neuropatía de grado ≥2 – interrupción permanente.
Do not continue maintenance with diagnos: No continúe el mantenimiento con segunda malignidad diagnosticada sin reevaluar el beneficio-riesgo.
Do not continue observation in the prese: No continúe la observación en presencia de metaplasia intestinal/displasia en biopsia, esto es precanceroso, requiere erradicación + endoscopia de vigilancia mejorada.
Do not continue observation when transfo: No continúe la observación cuando aparezcan las banderas de transformación (linfadenopatía rápida, síntomas B, aumento de la LDH) - ruta a la indicación de la persona de tratamiento.
Do not continue through Grade ≥3 irAE wi: No continúe a través de la EIRA de Grado ≥3 sin considerar la suspensión permanente.
Do not continue with active uncontrolled: Do not continue with active uncontrolled infection — pause until resolution is mandatory.
Do not continue with gr ≥3 irAE without: No continúe con gr ≥3 irAE sin esteroides de dosis alta (1-2 mg/kg equivalente a prednisolona) - el retraso en el tratamiento puede ser fatal.
No continúe con gr ≥3 irAE sin reevaluar el beneficio/riesgo: el adyuvante es intención curativa, umbral para la interrupción permanente inferior a la metastática.
Do not continue without response — if no: No continúe sin respuesta: si no hay TI a los 6 meses, detenga; considere una alternativa (luspatercept, imetelstat).
Do not default to medical therapy ahead: No deje de tratar la terapia médica antes de la evaluación quirúrgica para un adenoma de somatotropo quirurgico accesible sin discusión multidisciplinar.
Do not default to total bilateral adrena: No se incumpla la adrenalectomía total bilateral sin considerar la técnica de ahorramiento cortical en la enfermedad bilateral/hereditaria -- riesgo de insuficiencia suprarrenal permanente.
Do not defer prophylactic thyroidectomy: No aplace la tiroidectomía profiláctica en la clase HST (M918T) más allá del primer año de vida - MTC puede ser invasiva en la infancia.
Do not delay ENT-oncology referral for f: No retrase la remisión de la ENT-oncología para encontrar hallazgos de erosión de masa / ósea en la TC — es necesaria una biopsia rápida.
Do not delay GI screening to age 50 — fi: No retrase la detección de IG hasta los 50 años — la orientación de bomberos-cohortes apoya la consideración de la iniciación más temprana a los 40-45 años.
Do not delay chemotherapy with adequate: Do not delay chemotherapy with adequate prophylaxis — disease control critical for AML hyperleuk / Burkitt; balance risk.
Do not delay diagnostic workup of a susp: No retrase el análisis diagnóstico de un nódulo pulmonar sospechoso por Fleischner/Lung-RADS — el NSCLC en fase temprana tiene resultados significativamente mejores.
Do not delay donor search and pediatric: Do not delay donor search and pediatric transplant-center referral while trying non-curative bridge therapy.
Do not delay imaging-driven response thr: No retrase la respuesta por imágenes a través de 4 ciclos — PET provisional si hay preocupación por la transformación o progresión.
Do not delegate VHL surveillance to non-: Do not delegate VHL surveillance to non-specialists — multi-organ coordination requires a VHL-experienced center.
Do not delegate pancreatic surveillance: Do not delegate pancreatic surveillance to non-specialist centers — requires EUS expertise.
Do not delegate pediatric-cancer-survivo: Do not delegate pediatric-cancer-survivor surveillance to non-experienced clinics — COG-LTFU guidelines are complex.
Do not delegate pediatric-survivor surve: Do not delegate pediatric-survivor surveillance to non-experienced clinics — COG-LTFU guidelines are complex and require expertise.
Do not demonize individual foods — dieta: No demonice los alimentos individuales: el patrón dietético importa más que la eliminación de alimentos únicos.
Do not deny EBV-VL monitoring in the hig: No negar la monitorización de la VVB-EB en la cohorte post-transplante de alto riesgo (venda pre-tx + seropositivo del VBB-EC) — la intervención preventiva es la diferencia entre el éxito del tratamiento y la progresión del PTLD.
Do not deny FIT as the non-invasive CRC: Do not deny FIT as the non-invasive CRC first-choice — it substantially exceeds the no-screening baseline.
Do not deny LDCT access on socioeconomic: No deniegue el acceso a los PMAT por motivos socioeconómicos / seguros sin una referencia activa a Medicare / NHS / NSZU vía de cobertura equivalente.
Do not deny catch-up screening on socioe: No deniegue la detección de recuperación por motivos socioeconómicos / seguros — la mayoría de las modalidades son accesibles a través de NSZU / Medicare / NHS cobertura; determinación de documentos + coordinar activamente el acceso.
Do not deny dermatology / anoscopy / col: No negar el acceso a la dermatología/anoscopia/colposcopia en la presentación de los síntomas; el acceso anticipado por los síntomas es el respaldo para la vía decadencia declinada.
Do not deny mutual-support group engagem: No niegue el compromiso del grupo de apoyo mutuo (AA, SMART Recovery) sobre la base de la preferencia del médico, es un eje eficaz separado.
Do not deny the patient symptom-prompted: No niegue el acceso al endometrial/seno, aunque se deniegue la detección de rutina.
No niegue el acceso a la endoscopia, con síntomas, aunque se deniegue la vigilancia de rutina, debe estar disponible el GI.
No deniegue el acceso al examen de rutina, aunque se denieguen los exámenes de rutinario, el GYN debe estar disponible.
Do not deny vaccination on the basis of: No deniegue la vacunación sobre la base de la detección declinada: el eje de vacunación está separado de la cadencia de vigilancia.
Do not diagnose Cushing disease without: No diagnostique la enfermedad de Cushing sin confirmar la dependencia de ACTH y una fuente de hipercortisolismo hipofisaria (no ectópica ni suprarrenal).
Do not diagnose prolactinoma without exc: No diagnostique prolactinoma sin excluir las causas secundarias de hiperprolactinemia (efecto de la medicación, hipotiroidismo, insuficiencia renal, embarazo).
Do not dilute PLD in normal saline -- di: No diluya PLD en solución salina normal -- interrumpe los liposomas; D5W solamente.
Do not disable LDCT access on the basis: No desactivar el acceso al trato de los PMA sobre la base del programa declinado; la evaluación de la elegibilidad es un eje separado.
Do not discontinue ART during cancer tre: No interrumpa el tratamiento antirretroviral durante el tratamiento contra el cáncer sin consultar a un especialista en VIH.
Do not discontinue antiviral therapy wit: No interrumpa el tratamiento antiviral sin una consulta hepatológica, riesgo de reactivación grave del VHB.
Do not discontinue immunosuppression ent: No interrumpa totalmente la inmunosupresión -- la meta es el reequilibrio, no la retirada.
Do not dismiss unilateral symptoms as 'j: No descarte los síntomas unilaterales como 'sólo sinusitis' — la unilateralidad es una característica de alarma para la patología sinonasal.
Do not disregard hypertension on sunitin: No descuide la hipertensión en sunitinib en un paciente con un tumor que secreta la catecolamina -- los efectos pueden ser aditivos.
Do not disregard mediastinal mass airway: No desaproveche el compromiso de masa mediastinal de las vías aéreas — esteroides pre-inducción + preparación para la UTI.
Do not dose without weight — this is wei: No administrar una dosis sin peso, es una dosis SC basada en el peso.
Do not equate MUTYH-monoallelic carrier: No equipare el estado de portador monoalleico de MUTYH con el de FAP — MUTH biallenico = MAP (autosoma recesivo); MUTyH monoalléico solo presenta un riesgo modesto y no requiere una vigilancia mejorada.
